name: exists_nonzero
statement:
lemma exists_nonzero {f : SubRowLensType γ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1) : ∃ m, f.1 m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x ≠ 0 := hf ▸ (Nat.zero_ne_add_one k).symm
  simpa using hf'

name: extractOne_SubRowLensType
statement:
lemma extractOne_SubRowLensType {f : SubRowLensType γ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1) :
    (∀ i, γ.rowLen' i - (f.1 - extractOne hf) i ≥ γ.rowLen' (i + 1)) ∧
    (∀ i, (f.1 - extractOne hf) i ≤ γ.rowLen' i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    let hf' := f.2.1
    specialize hf' i
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, ge_iff_le]
    lia
  · intro i
    let hf' := f.2.2
    specialize hf' i
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, tsub_le_iff_right, ge_iff_le]
    lia

name: extractOne_le
statement:
lemma extractOne_le {f : SubRowLensType γ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1) : extractOne hf ≤ f.1
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  unfold extractOne
  by_cases hi : i = Classical.choose (exists_nonzero hf)
  · rw [hi, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| Classical.choose_spec (exists_nonzero hf)
  · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hi]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

name: extractOne_sub_add
proof:
:= by
  have hle := extractOne_le hf
  ext i
  specialize hle i
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
  lia

name: extractOne_le_sub
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [sub_rowLen']
  · simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply]
    grind [extractOne_le hf i]
  · intro i
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, ge_iff_le, tsub_le_iff_right]
    have := f.2.1 i
    lia

name: extractOne_rowLen'_sub_self_ge
statement:
lemma extractOne_rowLen'_sub_self_ge {f : SubRowLensType γ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1) : ∀ i,
    (γ.sub (f.1 - extractOne hf)).rowLen' i - extractOne hf i ≥
    (γ.sub (f.1 - extractOne hf)).rowLen' (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [sub_rowLen' <| sub_cond (extractOne_SubRowLensType hf).1]
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, ge_iff_le, tsub_le_iff_right]
  grind [extractOne_le hf i]

name: extractOne_sum_support
proof:
:= by
  simp [extractOne]

name: extractOne_sub_sum_support
proof:
:= by
  have : ∑ x ∈ (f.1 - extractOne hf).support,
      (f.1 - extractOne hf) x = ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, (f.1 - extractOne hf) x :=
    Finset.sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff Finsupp.support_tsub (by simp) (by simp)
  rw [this]
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_tsub_distrib, hf]
  · suffices ∑ x ∈ (extractOne hf).support, (extractOne hf) x =
        ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, (extractOne hf) x by
      rw [← this, extractOne_sum_support hf, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    exact Finset.sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff (Finsupp.support_mono (extractOne_le hf)) (by simp)
      (by simp)
  · intro x _
    exact extractOne_le hf x

name: sub_extractOne_eq_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hfi : ∀ i, γ.rowLen' i - (f.1 - extractOne hf) i ≥
      γ.rowLen' (i + 1) - (f.1 - extractOne hf) (i + 1) := by
    intro i
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, ge_iff_le, tsub_le_iff_right]
    have := f.2.1 i
    lia
  rw [← rowLen'_eq_iff, sub_rowLen' (sub_cond f.2.1),
    sub_rowLen', sub_rowLen' hfi]
  · ext i
    simp
    grind [extractOne_le hf i]
  · intro i
    simp [sub_rowLen' hfi]
    grind [extractOne_le hf i]

name: row_sorted
statement:
theorem row_sorted (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (i j : ℕ) (hj : j < γ.rowLen i) :
    T i j = ((List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (γ.rowLen i) ↦ T i k)).mergeSort (· ≤ ·))[j]'(by
      rwa [List.length_mergeSort, List.length_ofFn])
proof:
:= by
  have hTij : T i j = (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (γ.rowLen i) ↦ T i k))[j]'(by rwa [List.length_ofFn])
    := by simp
  rw [hTij]
  congr 1
  refine (List.mergeSort_of_pairwise ?_).symm
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, List.pairwise_ofFn]
  intro ⟨j1, _⟩ ⟨j2, hj2⟩ hj
  rw [Fin.mk_lt_mk] at hj
  refine T.row_weak hj ?_
  rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
  exact hj2

name: col_sorted
statement:
theorem col_sorted (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < γ.colLen j) :
    T i j = ((List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (γ.colLen j) ↦ T k j)).mergeSort (· ≤ ·))[i]'(by
      rwa [List.length_mergeSort, List.length_ofFn])
proof:
:= by
  have hTij : T i j = (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (γ.colLen j) ↦ T k j))[i]'(by
    rwa [List.length_ofFn]) := by simp
  rw [hTij]
  congr 1
  refine (List.mergeSort_of_pairwise ?_).symm
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, List.pairwise_ofFn]
  intro ⟨i1, _⟩ ⟨i2, hi2⟩ hi
  rw [Fin.mk_lt_mk] at hi
  refine le_of_lt <| T.col_strict hi ?_
  rwa [mem_iff_lt_colLen]

name: map_row
statement:
lemma map_row (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) {i : ℕ} :
    Multiset.map (fun j : Fin (γ.rowLen i) ↦ f i j.1)
      (Multiset.ofList (List.finRange (γ.rowLen i))) =
    Multiset.map (fun x : ℕ × ℕ ↦ f x.1 x.2) (γ.row i).val
proof:
:= by
  let e : (a : Fin (γ.rowLen i)) → (a ∈ (Multiset.ofList (List.finRange (γ.rowLen i)))) →
    (ℕ × ℕ) := fun a ha ↦ (i, a.1)
  refine Multiset.map_eq_map_of_bij_of_nodup _ _ ?_ (γ.row i).nodup e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Multiset.coe_nodup]
    exact List.nodup_finRange (γ.rowLen i)
  · intro ⟨a, ha⟩ ha'
    rw [← mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at ha
    simp [Finset.mem_val, mem_row_iff, e, ha]
  · grind
  · intro x
    simp only [Finset.mem_val, mem_row_iff, Multiset.mem_coe, List.mem_finRange, exists_const,
      and_imp, e]
    intro hx hxi
    use ⟨x.2, by rwa [← hxi, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen]⟩
    simp [← hxi]
  · grind

name: map_col
statement:
lemma map_col (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) {j : ℕ} :
    Multiset.map (fun i : Fin (γ.colLen j) ↦ f i j)
    (Multiset.ofList (List.finRange (γ.colLen j))) =
    Multiset.map (fun x : ℕ × ℕ ↦ f x.1 x.2) (γ.col j).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rowLen_transpose, col_eq_image_swap_transpose, Finset.image_val_of_injOn,
    Multiset.map_map]
  · exact map_row (fun i j ↦ f j i)
  · exact Set.injOn_of_injective Prod.swap_injective

name: eq_entry_of_map_row
statement:
theorem eq_entry_of_map_row {γ : YoungDiagram} (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ)
    (T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (i j : ℕ)
    (h : Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T x.1 x.2) (γ.row i).val =
    Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T' x.1 x.2) (γ.row i).val) : T i j = T' i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ γ
  · rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at hij
    rw [row_sorted T i j hij, row_sorted T' i j hij]
    congr 1
    refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _)
      (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) <| List.Perm.symm ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) ?_
    rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, List.ofFn_eq_map, List.ofFn_eq_map, ← Multiset.map_coe,
      ← Multiset.map_coe, map_row, map_row]
    exact h.symm
  · rw [T.zeros hij, T'.zeros hij]

name: cells_add_sub_row
statement: lemma cells_add_sub_row (i : ℕ) : (γ.cells.val - (γ.row i).val) + (γ.row i).val = γ.cells.val
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.add_sub_cancel ?_
  rw [Finset.val_le_iff]
  exact Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: eq_of_missing_row''
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_row'' {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ)
    (T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ') (hγ : γ = γ') (hc : T.content = T'.content) (i₀ : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ≠ i₀, ∀ j, T i j = T' i j) : T.entry = T'.entry
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i ≠ i₀
  · exact h i hi j
  push Not at hi
  simp only [content] at hc
  by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ γ
  · rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at hij
    let hij' := hij; rw [hγ] at hij'
    rw [to_fun_eq_coe, row_sorted T i j hij, to_fun_eq_coe, row_sorted T' i j hij']
    congr 1
    refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _)
      (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) <| List.Perm.symm ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) ?_
    rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, List.ofFn_eq_map, List.ofFn_eq_map, ← Multiset.map_coe,
      ← Multiset.map_coe, map_row, map_row]
    nth_rw 2 [← cells_add_sub_row i] at hc
    nth_rw 1 [← cells_add_sub_row i] at hc
    simp only [Multiset.map_add] at hc
    suffices Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T x.1 x.2) (γ.cells.val - (γ.row i).val) =
        Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T' x.1 x.2) (γ'.cells.val - (γ'.row i).val) by
      rw [this, add_right_inj] at hc
      exact hc.symm
    simp only [← hγ]
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro (a, b) hab
    simp only
    by_cases habγ : (a, b) ∈ γ
    · rw [← Multiset.count_pos, Multiset.count_sub, tsub_pos_iff_lt,
        Multiset.count_eq_of_nodup (γ.row i).nodup,
        Multiset.count_eq_of_nodup γ.cells.nodup] at hab
      simp only [Finset.mem_val, mem_row_iff, habγ, true_and, mem_cells, ↓reduceIte, Nat.lt_one_iff,
        ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false, hi] at hab
      exact h a hab b
    · rw [T.zeros habγ, T'.zeros (hγ ▸ habγ)]
  · rw [to_fun_eq_coe, to_fun_eq_coe, T.zeros hij, T'.zeros (hγ ▸ hij)]

name: eq_of_missing_row
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_row (T T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hc : T.content = T'.content)
    (i₀ : ℕ) (h : ∀ i ≠ i₀, ∀ j, T i j = T' i j) : T = T'
proof:
:= by
  suffices T.entry = T'.entry by exact ext fun i ↦ congrFun (congrFun this i)
  exact eq_of_missing_row'' T T' rfl hc i₀ h

name: eq_of_missing_row'
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_row' (T T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hc : T.content = T'.content)
    (i₀ : ℕ) {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (h : ∀ i ≠ i₀, ∀ j, T i j = f i j)
    (h' : ∀ i ≠ i₀, ∀ j, T' i j = f i j) : T = T'
proof:
:=
  eq_of_missing_row T T' hc i₀ (by grind)

name: cells_add_sub_col
statement: lemma cells_add_sub_col (j : ℕ) : (γ.cells.val - (γ.col j).val) + (γ.col j).val = γ.cells.val
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.add_sub_cancel ?_
  rw [Finset.val_le_iff]
  exact Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: eq_of_missing_col''
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_col'' {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ)
    (T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ') (hγ : γ = γ') (hc : T.content = T'.content) (j₀ : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, ∀ j ≠ j₀, T i j = T' i j) : T.entry = T'.entry
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hj : j ≠ j₀
  · exact h i j hj
  push Not at hj
  simp only [content] at hc
  by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ γ
  · rw [mem_iff_lt_colLen] at hij
    let hij' := hij; rw [hγ] at hij'
    rw [to_fun_eq_coe, col_sorted T i j hij, to_fun_eq_coe, col_sorted T' i j hij']
    congr 1
    refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _)
      (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) <| List.Perm.symm ?_
    refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) ?_
    rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, List.ofFn_eq_map, List.ofFn_eq_map, ← Multiset.map_coe,
      ← Multiset.map_coe, map_col, map_col]
    nth_rw 2 [← cells_add_sub_col j] at hc
    nth_rw 1 [← cells_add_sub_col j] at hc
    simp only [Multiset.map_add] at hc
    suffices Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T x.1 x.2) (γ.cells.val - (γ.col j).val) =
        Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T' x.1 x.2) (γ'.cells.val - (γ'.col j).val) by
      rw [this, add_right_inj] at hc
      exact hc.symm
    simp only [← hγ]
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro (a, b) hab
    simp only
    by_cases habγ : (a, b) ∈ γ
    · rw [← Multiset.count_pos, Multiset.count_sub, tsub_pos_iff_lt,
        Multiset.count_eq_of_nodup (γ.col j).nodup,
        Multiset.count_eq_of_nodup γ.cells.nodup] at hab
      simp only [Finset.mem_val, mem_col_iff, habγ, true_and, mem_cells, ↓reduceIte, Nat.lt_one_iff,
        ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false, hj] at hab
      exact h a b hab
    · rw [T.zeros habγ, T'.zeros (hγ ▸ habγ)]
  · rw [to_fun_eq_coe, to_fun_eq_coe, T.zeros hij, T'.zeros (hγ ▸ hij)]

name: eq_of_missing_col
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_col (T T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hc : T.content = T'.content)
    (j₀ : ℕ) (h : ∀ i, ∀ j ≠ j₀, T i j = T' i j) : T = T'
proof:
:= by
  suffices T.entry = T'.entry by exact ext fun i ↦ congrFun (congrFun this i)
  exact eq_of_missing_col'' T T' rfl hc j₀ h

name: eq_of_missing_col'
statement:
theorem eq_of_missing_col' (T T' : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hc : T.content = T'.content)
    (j₀ : ℕ) {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (h : ∀ i, ∀ j ≠ j₀, T i j = f i j)
    (h' : ∀ i, ∀ j ≠ j₀, T' i j = f i j) : T = T'
proof:
:=
  eq_of_missing_col T T' hc j₀ (by grind)

name: YoungDiagram.hookDiagram_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hookDiagram_card (n : ℕ) : (hookDiagram n).card = n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : n ≥ 2
  · rw! [← ofRowLens_to_rowLens_eq_self (μ := hookDiagram n), hookDiagram_rowLens hn,
      card_ofRowLens]
    all_goals grind
  · interval_cases n <;> simp

name: YoungDiagram.hookDiagram_cells
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_hookDiagram (n + 1) (by lia), Prod.ext_iff]

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.entry_lt_card
statement:
lemma entry_lt_card {μ : Multiset ℕ} (h : T.content = μ.fromCounts) {i j : ℕ}
    (hij : (i, j) ∈ γ) : T i j < μ.card
proof:
:= by
  have := h ▸ mem_content_of_mem hij
  contrapose! this
  exact Multiset.notMem_fromCounts μ (T i j) this

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.top_left_eq_zero_of_content_eq_fromCounts
statement:
theorem top_left_eq_zero_of_content_eq_fromCounts {μ : Multiset ℕ}
    (h : T.content = μ.fromCounts) : T 0 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hγ : γ = ⊥
  · exact entry_eq_zero_of_bot T hγ
  have h0 : 0 ∈ μ.fromCounts := by
    refine Multiset.zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty ?_
    rwa [← h, ne_eq, ← bot_eq_zero, content_eq_bot_iff]
  simp only [← h, content, Multiset.mem_map, Finset.mem_val, mem_cells, Prod.exists] at h0
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hT⟩ := h0
  refine antisymm ?_ (Nat.zero_le (T 0 0))
  nth_rw 3 [← hT]
  refine le_trans (T.col_weak (Nat.zero_le i) <| γ.up_left_mem (by rfl) (Nat.zero_le j) hij) ?_
  exact T.row_weak_of_le (Nat.zero_le j) hij

name: Kostka.content_SSYTBot
statement: @[simp] lemma content_SSYTBot (T : SemistandardYoungTableau ⊥) : T.content = ⊥
proof:

name: Kostka.entry_SSYTBot
statement: @[simp] lemma entry_SSYTBot (T : SemistandardYoungTableau ⊥) (i j : ℕ) : T i j = 0

  T.zeros (notMem_bot (i, j))

name: Kostka.card_SSYTBot

name: Kostka.kostka_bot_bot
statement: lemma kostka_bot_bot : kostkaNumber ⊥ ⊥ = 1
proof:

name: YoungDiagram.mem_horizontalDiagram
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_horizontalDiagram (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ) : x ∈ horizontalDiagram n ↔
    x.1 = 0 ∧ x.2 < n
proof:
:= by
  simp [horizontalDiagram, ofRowLens, YoungDiagram.cellsOfRowLens]

name: YoungDiagram.horizontalDiagram_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma horizontalDiagram_zero : horizontalDiagram 0 = ⊥

name: YoungDiagram.horizontalDiagram_succ
statement:
lemma horizontalDiagram_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (horizontalDiagram (n + 1)).cells.val = (0 , n) ::ₘ (horizontalDiagram n).cells.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [horizontalDiagram, ofRowLens, YoungDiagram.cellsOfRowLens]

name: YoungDiagram.horizontalDiagram_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma horizontalDiagram_card {n : ℕ} : (horizontalDiagram n).card = n

name: YoungDiagram.horizontalDiagram_rowLens
statement:
@[simp]
lemma horizontalDiagram_rowLens {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (horizontalDiagram n).rowLens = [n]

name: YoungDiagram.hookDiagram_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma hookDiagram_zero : hookDiagram 0 = ⊥

name: YoungDiagram.hookDiagram_one

name: YoungDiagram.hookDiagram_rowLens

name: YoungDiagram.mem_hookDiagram

  simp [hookDiagram, Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn, Nat.ne_of_lt' hn, ofRowLens, YoungDiagram.cellsOfRowLens]

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_eq_bot_iff

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.mem_content_of_mem

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.entry_le_max
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : T i j = 0
  · exact hij ▸ Nat.zero_le _
  · exact List.le_max_of_mem (by simp [mem_content_of_nonzero hij])

name: Kostka.finite_SSYTWithContent
statement:
lemma finite_SSYTWithContent (γ : YoungDiagram) (μ : Multiset ℕ) :
    Finite (SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ)
proof:
:= by
  let f : {T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ | T.content = μ.fromCounts} →
    (γ.cells → {n // n ∈ μ.fromCounts}) := fun ⟨T, hT⟩ ↦ (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨T x.1 x.2,
      hT ▸ mem_content_of_mem hx⟩)
  refine Finite.of_injective f ?_
  intro ⟨T, hT⟩ ⟨T', hT'⟩ hf
  simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ γ
  · have hf : (f ⟨T, hT⟩) ⟨(i, j), hij⟩ = (f ⟨T', hT'⟩) ⟨(i, j), hij⟩ := congrFun hf ⟨(i, j), hij⟩
    simpa [Set.coe_setOf, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Subtype.mk.injEq, f] using hf
  · rw [T.zeros hij, T'.zeros hij]

name: Kostka.kostka_eq_card_SSYTWithContent
statement:
lemma kostka_eq_card_SSYTWithContent : kostkaNumber γ μ =
    Nat.card (SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [kostkaNumber, SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent]

name: Kostka.kostka_eq_zero
statement:
theorem kostka_eq_zero {γ : YoungDiagram} {μ : Multiset ℕ}
    (h : ∀ T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ, T.content ≠ μ.fromCounts) : kostkaNumber γ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostkaNumber, Nat.card_eq_zero]
  left
  exact Subtype.isEmpty_of_false h

name: Kostka.kostka_eq_zero_iff_forall_not
statement:
theorem kostka_eq_zero_iff_forall_not {γ : YoungDiagram} {μ : Multiset ℕ} :
    kostkaNumber γ μ = 0 ↔ ∀ T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ, T.content ≠ μ.fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    contrapose! h
    simp only [kostkaNumber, Set.coe_setOf, nonempty_subtype, h, ne_eq, Nat.card_eq_zero,
      not_isEmpty_of_nonempty, false_or, not_infinite_iff_finite]
    exact finite_SSYTWithContent γ μ
  · exact kostka_eq_zero

name: Kostka.kostka_ne_card
statement:
theorem kostka_ne_card (γ : YoungDiagram) (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : γ.card ≠ μ.sum) :
    kostkaNumber γ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine kostka_eq_zero ?_
  intro T
  contrapose! h
  rw [← Multiset.fromCounts_card, ← h]
  exact content_card_eq_card.symm

name: get_zero_ge_of_dominates
statement:
lemma get_zero_ge_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (h : L ⊵ L') (hL : 0 < L.length)
    (hL' : 0 < L'.length) : L[0] ≥ L'[0]
proof:
:= by
  specialize h 0
  have hL0 : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L.length => i.1 ≤ 0) Finset.univ = {⟨0, hL⟩} := by
    ext x; simp [Fin.eq_mk_iff_val_eq]
  have hL'0 : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L'.length => i.1 ≤ 0) Finset.univ = {⟨0, hL'⟩} := by
    ext x; simp [Fin.eq_mk_iff_val_eq]
  rwa [hL0, hL'0, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton,
    List.get_eq_getElem, List.get_eq_getElem] at h

name: lengths_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma lengths_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊵ L') (h : L.sum = L'.sum)
    (hp : ∀ i, L.get i > 0) :
    L.length ≤ L'.length
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : L'.length = 0
  · rw [h0]
    suffices Multiset.ofList L = 0 by simpa using this
    rw [← Multiset.sum_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero, Multiset.sum_coe, h]
    · simp only [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      rw [h0, List.sum_nil]
    · grind [Multiset.mem_coe, List.get_of_mem]
  contrapose! h
  specialize hd (L'.length-1)
  refine ne_of_gt ?_
  simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, ge_iff_le] at hd
  have hLs : L'.sum = ∑ x : Fin L'.length with x.1 ≤ L'.length - 1, L'[x.1] := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_getElem]
    congr
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_filter, true_and, true_iff]
    exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt x.2
  rw [hLs]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt hd ?_
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_getElem]
  let i := (⟨L.length - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt h⟩ : Fin L.length)
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_subset ?_ (Finset.mem_univ i) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp [i]
    lia
  · rw [← List.get_eq_getElem]
    exact hp i
  · simp

name: sum_two_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma sum_two_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L')
  (hL : 1 < L.length) (hL' : 1 < L'.length) : L[0] + L[1] ≤ L'[0] + L'[1]
proof:
:= by
  specialize hd 1
  have hL1 : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L.length => i.1 ≤ 1) Finset.univ =
      {⟨0, by lia⟩, ⟨1, hL⟩} := by grind
  have hL'1 : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L'.length => i.1 ≤ 1) Finset.univ =
      {⟨0, by lia⟩, ⟨1, hL'⟩} := by grind
  grind

name: sum_three_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma sum_three_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L')
    (hL : 2 < L.length) (hL' : 2 < L'.length) :
    L[0] + L[1] + L[2] ≤ L'[0] + L'[1] + L'[2]
proof:
:= by
  specialize hd 2
  have hL1 : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L.length => i.1 ≤ 2) Finset.univ =
      {⟨0, by lia⟩, ⟨1, by lia⟩, ⟨2, hL⟩} := by grind
  have hL1' : Finset.filter (fun i : Fin L'.length => i.1 ≤ 2) Finset.univ =
      {⟨0, by lia⟩, ⟨1, by lia⟩, ⟨2, hL'⟩} := by grind
  grind

name: dominates_self
statement: @[simp] lemma dominates_self {L : List ℕ} : L ⊴ L
proof: := by intro r; rfl

name: dominates_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma dominates_nil {L : List ℕ} : [] ⊴ L
proof: := by intro r; simp

name: dominates_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma dominates_zero {L : List ℕ} : [0] ⊴ L
proof: := by intro r; simp

name: nil_dominates_of_sum_eq_zero
statement: lemma nil_dominates_of_sum_eq_zero {L : List ℕ} (h : L.sum = 0) : L ⊴ []
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.sum_eq_zero_iff, List.mem_iff_get, List.get_eq_getElem] at h
  intro r
  simp only [List.length_nil, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.filter_empty, List.get_eq_getElem,
    Finset.sum_empty, ge_iff_le, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro i hi
  exact h L[i.1] (by use i)

name: sum_with_eq_sum_with_length
statement:
lemma sum_with_eq_sum_with_length {L : List ℕ} {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i =
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ L.length - 1, L.get i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_subset (by grind) (by grind)).symm

name: sum_with_eq_sum_with
statement:
lemma sum_with_eq_sum_with {L : List ℕ} {r s : ℕ} (hr : r ≥ L.length - 1) (hs : s ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i =
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ s, L.get i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_with_eq_sum_with_length hr, sum_with_eq_sum_with_length hs]

name: sum_with_eq_sum_univ
statement:
lemma sum_with_eq_sum_univ {L : List ℕ} (r : ℕ) (h : r ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i, L.get i = ∑ i with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_subset (by simp) (by grind)).symm

name: dominates_of_forall_lt_length
statement:
lemma dominates_of_forall_lt_length {L L' : List ℕ} (h : ∀ r < L.length,
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i ≤
    ∑ i : Fin L'.length with i.1 ≤ r, L'.get i) :
    L ⊴ L'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hL0 : L.length = 0
  · grind [dominates_nil]
  by_cases! hL0' : L'.length = 0
  · specialize h (L.length - 1) (by lia)
    simp_rw [← sum_with_eq_sum_univ _ (by rfl), List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.sum_univ_getElem] at h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, Nat.le_zero] at h
    · rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hL0'
      rw [hL0']
      exact nil_dominates_of_sum_eq_zero h
    · lia
  intro r
  have hle : min L.length L'.length ≠ 0 := by grind
  by_cases hr : r < L.length
  · exact h r hr
  · push Not at hr
    have hr : r ≥ L.length - 1 := by lia
    rw [sum_with_eq_sum_with hr (by rfl)]
    specialize h (L.length - 1) (by grind)
    refine le_trans h <| Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset ?_
    grind

name: dominates_of_forall_lt_min
statement:
lemma dominates_of_forall_lt_min {L L' : List ℕ} (h : ∀ r < min L.length L'.length,
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i ≤
    ∑ i : Fin L'.length with i.1 ≤ r, L'.get i) (hs : L.sum = L'.sum) : L ⊴ L'
proof:
:= by
  refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
  intro r hr'
  by_cases hr : r < min L.length L'.length
  · exact h r hr
  · push Not at hr
    conv => rhs; rw [← sum_with_eq_sum_univ _ (by grind)]
    simp_rw [List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.sum_univ_getElem, ← hs, ← Fin.sum_univ_getElem]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset ?_
    simp

name: sum_le_sum_of_dominates
statement: lemma sum_le_sum_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L') : L.sum ≤ L'.sum
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Fin.sum_univ_getElem, ← List.get_eq_getElem]
  rw [sum_with_eq_sum_univ (max L.length L'.length - 1) (by grind),
    sum_with_eq_sum_univ (max L.length L'.length - 1) (by grind)]
  exact hd (max L.length L'.length - 1)

name: dominates_singleton_iff
statement:
lemma dominates_singleton_iff {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ i : Fin (L.length), L[i.1] > 0) : ([n] ⊴ L) ↔ L = [n]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    have hL : L.length ≤ 1 := by
      apply lengths_le_of_dominates at hd
      simpa [h, hp] using hd
    have hL0 : L.length > 0 := by
      refine List.length_pos_of_sum_ne_zero _ ?_
      rwa [h]
    have hL1 : L.length = 1 := by lia
    rw [List.length_eq_one_iff] at hL1
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hL1
    rw [hm, List.sum_singleton] at h
    rw [hm, h]
  · exact (· ▸ dominates_self)

name: List.forall_mem_eq_one_of_length_eq_sum
statement:
private lemma List.forall_mem_eq_one_of_length_eq_sum {L : List ℕ} (h : L.length = L.sum)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, x > 0) : ∀ x ∈ L, x = 1
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  obtain ⟨x, hxL, hx⟩ := h
  have hxL' := hxL
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at hxL
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨hn, hnx⟩⟩ := hxL
  refine ne_of_lt ?_
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_getElem, ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ ⟨n, hn⟩)]
  suffices L.length - 1 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin (L.length)), L[i.1] by grind
  refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ 1 ?_)
  · simp
  · grind [List.getElem_mem]

name: replicate_one_dominates_iff
statement:
lemma replicate_one_dominates_iff {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, x > 0) :
    (L ⊴ (List.replicate n 1)) ↔ L = List.replicate n 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    rw [List.eq_replicate_iff]
    suffices L.length = n by
      constructor
      · exact this
      · refine List.forall_mem_eq_one_of_length_eq_sum ?_ hp
        rw [this, h]
    apply lengths_le_of_dominates at hd
    specialize hd ?_ ?_
    · rw [h, List.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    · simp
    · rw [List.length_replicate] at hd
      refine antisymm ?_ hd
      rw [← h]
      exact List.length_le_sum_of_one_le _ hp
  · exact (· ▸ dominates_self)

name: dominates_replicate_one
statement:
lemma dominates_replicate_one {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, x > 0) : (List.replicate n 1) ⊴ L
proof:
:= by
  refine dominates_of_forall_lt_min ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_replicate, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ 1 ?_)
    · have hiic : ({i : Fin (List.replicate n 1).length | i ≤ r} : Finset _) =
        Finset.Iic ⟨r, by grind⟩ := by grind
      have hiic' : ({i : Fin L.length | i ≤ r} : Finset _) =
        Finset.Iic ⟨r, by grind⟩ := by grind
      simp [hiic, hiic', Fin.card_Iic]
    · intro i _
      exact hp L[i.1] (List.getElem_mem (Fin.val_lt_of_le i (le_refl L.length)))
  · simp [h]

name: singleton_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma singleton_dominates_singleton {a b : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b]) ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp [h]

name: singleton_dominates_pair
statement: lemma singleton_dominates_pair {a b c : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c]) ↔ a + b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, h] <;> lia

name: singleton_dominates_triple
statement: lemma singleton_dominates_triple {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d]) ↔ a + b + c ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
    simpa [← add_assoc] using h
  · intro h
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_three, h] <;> lia

name: pair_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma pair_dominates_singleton {a b c : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b, c]) ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
    all_goals simp
  · intro h
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, h]

name: pair_dominates_pair
statement: lemma pair_dominates_pair {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c, d]) ↔ a ≤ c ∧ a + b ≤ c + d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    · apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
      simpa using h
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, h₁, h₂]

name: pair_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma pair_dominates_triple {a b c d e : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    · apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
      simpa [add_assoc] using h
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_three, h₁, h₂] <;> lia

name: triple_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma triple_dominates_singleton {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b, c, d]) ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
    all_goals simp
  · intro h
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, h]

name: triple_dominates_pair
statement:
lemma triple_dominates_pair {a b c d e : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c, d, e]) ↔
    a ≤ c ∧ a + b ≤ c + d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    · refine sum_two_le_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_three, h₁, h₂]

name: triple_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma triple_dominates_triple {a b c d e f : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e, f]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b ≤ d + e ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e + f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor; swap; constructor
    · refine sum_two_le_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    · apply sum_le_sum_of_dominates at h
      simpa [← add_assoc] using h
    · refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_three, h₁, h₂, h₃]

name: quad_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma quad_dominates_triple {a b c d e f g : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e, f, g]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b ≤ d + e ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e + f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · refine get_zero_ge_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    constructor
    · refine sum_two_le_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
    · refine sum_three_le_of_dominates h ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    refine dominates_of_forall_lt_length ?_
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd]
    intro r hr
    interval_cases r
    all_goals simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_four, h₁, h₂, h₃]

name: YoungDiagram.bot_card
statement: @[simp] lemma bot_card : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).card = 0
proof: := by simp

name: YoungDiagram.bot_rowLens
statement: @[simp] lemma bot_rowLens : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).rowLens = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [rowLens, colLen]

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem : γ = ⊥ ↔ ∀ i j : ℕ, (i, j) ∉ γ
proof:
:= by
  simp [YoungDiagram.ext_iff, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero : γ = ⊥ ↔ γ.card = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [YoungDiagram.ext_iff]

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_zero_zero_notMem
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_zero_zero_notMem : γ = ⊥ ↔ (0, 0) ∉ γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h 0 0, fun h i j ↦ ?_⟩
  contrapose! h
  exact γ.up_left_mem i.zero_le j.zero_le h

name: YoungDiagram.eq_iff_rowLens_eq
statement: lemma eq_iff_rowLens_eq {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} : γ = γ' ↔ γ.rowLens = γ'.rowLens
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← equivListRowLens_apply_coe, Subtype.coe_inj, equivListRowLens.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: YoungDiagram.eq_iff_rowLens_eq'
statement:
lemma eq_iff_rowLens_eq' {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} :
    γ = γ' ↔ Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens = Multiset.ofList γ'.rowLens
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq, Multiset.coe_eq_coe,
    List.perm_iff_eq_of_sortedGE γ.rowLens_sorted γ'.rowLens_sorted]

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_mono
statement: lemma colLen_mono {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) (j : ℕ) : γ'.colLen j ≤ γ.colLen j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra!
  rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen] at this
  apply h at this
  simp [mem_iff_lt_colLen] at this

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_mono
statement: lemma rowLen_mono {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) (i : ℕ) : γ'.rowLen i ≤ γ.rowLen i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra!
  rw [← mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at this
  apply h at this
  simp [mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at this

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rowLen_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).rowLen = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [Pi.zero_apply, ← le_zero_iff, ← Std.not_lt, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
  exact notMem_bot _

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma colLen_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).colLen = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [Pi.zero_apply, ← le_zero_iff, ← Std.not_lt, ← mem_iff_lt_colLen]
  exact notMem_bot _

name: YoungDiagram.card_sdiff
statement:
lemma card_sdiff {γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) :
    (γ.cells \ γ'.cells).card = γ.card - γ'.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [YoungDiagram.card, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset h]

name: YoungDiagram.row_transpose
statement:
lemma row_transpose (γ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) : γ.transpose.row i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.col i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [row, col]
  grind

name: YoungDiagram.col_transpose
statement:
lemma col_transpose (γ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) : γ.transpose.col i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.row i)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← transpose_transpose γ]
  rw [row_transpose γ.transpose, Finset.image_image, Prod.swap_swap_eq, Finset.image_id]

name: YoungDiagram.col_eq_image_swap_transpose
statement:
lemma col_eq_image_swap_transpose {γ : YoungDiagram} (i : ℕ) : γ.col i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.transpose.row i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [row_transpose, Finset.image_image, Prod.swap_swap_eq, Finset.image_id]

name: YoungDiagram.row_eq_image_swap_transpose
statement:
lemma row_eq_image_swap_transpose {γ : YoungDiagram} (i : ℕ) : γ.row i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.transpose.col i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [col_transpose, Finset.image_image, Prod.swap_swap_eq, Finset.image_id]

name: Multiset.remove_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma remove_bot : remove (⊥ : Multiset α) a = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove]

name: Multiset.remove_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma remove_zero : remove 0 a = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove]

name: Multiset.notMem_of_remove
statement:
@[grind ., simp]
lemma notMem_of_remove : a ∉ S.remove a
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove, ← count_eq_zero]

name: Multiset.remove_of_notMem
statement: lemma remove_of_notMem (ha : a ∉ S) : S.remove a = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_pos, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at ha
  push Not at ha
  rw [remove, ha, replicate_zero, Multiset.sub_zero]

name: Multiset.mem_remove_of_ne
statement: lemma mem_remove_of_ne {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) : b ∈ S.remove a ↔ b ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove, mem_sub, count_replicate, h, count_pos]

name: Multiset.mem_remove_of_mem
statement: lemma mem_remove_of_mem (b : α) (h : a ∈ S) : a ∈ S.remove b ↔ b ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  grind [mem_remove_of_ne]

name: Multiset.mem_of_mem_remove
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_remove (h : b ∈ S.remove a) : b ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_pos]
  rw [remove, mem_sub] at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) h

name: Multiset.insert_remove_toFinset
statement: lemma insert_remove_toFinset (ha : a ∈ S) : insert a (S.remove a).toFinset = S.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  grind [mem_of_mem_remove, mem_remove_of_ne]

name: Multiset.remove_toFinset
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma remove_toFinset (S : Multiset α) (a : α) : (S.remove a).toFinset = S.toFinset.erase a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ S
  · grind [insert_remove_toFinset]
  · grind [remove_of_notMem]

name: Multiset.remove_toFinset_card
statement:
lemma remove_toFinset_card (S : Multiset α) (a : α) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    (S.remove a).toFinset.card = S.toFinset.card - 1
proof: := by grind

name: Multiset.remove_zero_sum
statement: lemma remove_zero_sum (μ : Multiset ℕ) : μ.sum = (μ.remove 0).sum
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h0 : 0 ∉ μ
  · rw [remove_of_notMem μ 0 h0]
  simp only [Finset.sum_multiset_count, smul_eq_mul, remove, count_sub, count_replicate]
  rw [← insert_remove_toFinset h0, Finset.sum_insert_zero]
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (by grind)
  · rw [mul_zero]

name: Multiset.cons_remove
statement: lemma cons_remove {μ : Multiset α} (a : α) : (a ::ₘ μ).remove a = μ.remove a
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove]

name: Multiset.sub_card_le_card
statement: lemma sub_card_le_card {s t : Multiset α} : (s - t).card ≤ s.card
proof:
:= by
  exact card_le_card <| Multiset.sub_le_self s t

name: Multiset.remove_card_le_card
statement: lemma remove_card_le_card {μ : Multiset α} {a : α} : (μ.remove a).card ≤ μ.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove, sub_card_le_card]

name: Multiset.remove_replicate
statement: lemma remove_replicate {n : ℕ} {a b : α} (h : a = b) : (Multiset.replicate n a).remove b = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [remove, h]

name: Multiset.remove_add
statement: lemma remove_add {s t : Multiset α} (a : α) : (s + t).remove a = s.remove a + t.remove a
proof:
:= by
  rw [remove, count_add, replicate_add, tsub_add_eq_tsub_tsub, add_comm, add_tsub_assoc_of_le,
    add_comm, add_tsub_assoc_of_le, remove, remove]
  · rw [← Multiset.filter_eq]
    exact filter_le _ t
  · rw [← Multiset.filter_eq]
    exact filter_le _ s

name: Multiset.sub_remove
statement: lemma sub_remove {s : Multiset α} {a : α} : s - (s.remove a) = replicate (count a s) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [remove, tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le]
  rw [← Multiset.filter_eq]
  exact filter_le _ s

name: Multiset.zero_notMem_counts
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_notMem_counts : 0 ∉ M.counts
proof: := by simp [counts]

name: Multiset.counts_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma counts_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ M.counts) : n > 0
proof:
:= by
  grind [zero_notMem_counts]

name: Multiset.bot_counts_iff
statement: lemma bot_counts_iff : M.counts = ⊥ ↔ M = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [counts, dedup_eq_zero]

name: Multiset.sum_counts_eq_card
statement: lemma sum_counts_eq_card : M.counts.sum = M.card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [counts, Finset.sum_multiset_map_count, toFinset_dedup, count_dedup, smul_eq_mul,
    ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
    ← Multiset.sum_count_eq_card (s := M.toFinset) (m := M) (by simp)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (by grind)

name: Multiset.counts_card
statement: lemma counts_card : M.counts.card = M.toFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [counts, card_map]
  rfl

name: Multiset.counts_replicate
statement: lemma counts_replicate {n : ℕ} (a : α) (hn : n ≠ 0) : (replicate n a).counts = {n}
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [counts, count_replicate, map_eq_singleton]
  use a
  simp [← nsmul_singleton, dedup_nsmul hn]

name: Multiset.replicate_dedup
statement: lemma replicate_dedup {x : α} {k : ℕ} (h : k ≠ 0) : (replicate k x).dedup = {x}
proof:
:= by
  simp [← coe_replicate, List.replicate_dedup h]

name: Multiset.replicate_add_counts_of_notMem
statement:
lemma replicate_add_counts_of_notMem {a : α} {M : Multiset α} {n : ℕ} (h : a ∉ M) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ((replicate n a) + M).counts = {n} + M.counts
proof:
:= by
  simp only [counts, count_add, count_replicate]
  ext m
  rw [count_add, count_map, count_map, Disjoint.dedup_add, replicate_dedup hn, filter_add,
    card_add]
  · by_cases hmn : m = n
    · simp only [hmn, nodup_singleton, mem_singleton, count_eq_one_of_mem]
      · congr 2
        · rw [card_eq_one]
          use a
          simp [h]
        · exact filter_congr (by grind [mem_dedup])
    · rw [← count_pos, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at h
      push Not at h
      simp only [filter_singleton, ↓reduceIte, h, add_zero, hmn, empty_eq_zero, card_zero,
        mem_singleton, not_false_eq_true, count_eq_zero_of_notMem]
      congr 2
      refine filter_congr ?_
      intro x hx
      have hax : a ≠ x := by
        rw [mem_dedup, ← count_pos, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at hx
        grind
      simp [hax]
  · refine disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    simp_all [mem_replicate]

name: List.sortedGE_replicate
statement:
lemma sortedGE_replicate {α : Type*} [Preorder α] {a : α} (n : ℕ) :
    (replicate n a).SortedGE
proof: := pairwise_replicate_of_refl.sortedGE

name: List.perm_iff_eq_of_sortedGE
statement:
lemma perm_iff_eq_of_sortedGE {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h₁ : l₁.SortedGE)
    (h₂ : l₂.SortedGE) : l₁.Perm l₂ ↔ l₁ = l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨List.Perm.eq_of_sortedGE h₁ h₂, List.Perm.of_eq⟩

name: List.pairwise_append_singleton
statement:
lemma pairwise_append_singleton {L : List α} (hL : Pairwise R L) (h : ∀ y ∈ L, R y x) :
    Pairwise R (L ++ [x])
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pairwise_append, hL]

name: List.max_eq_bot_iff
statement:
lemma max_eq_bot_iff {α : Type*} [Max α] [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] [Std.LawfulOrderSup α]
    {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    l.max hl = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eq_bot_iff, List.max_le_iff]

name: List.min_eq_bot_of_bot_mem
statement:
lemma min_eq_bot_of_bot_mem {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [OrderBot α]
    {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) (h : ⊥ ∈ l) :
    l.min hl = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  exact min_le_of_mem h

name: List.mem_tail_of_mem_ne_head
statement:
lemma mem_tail_of_mem_ne_head {α : Type*} {l : List α} {a : α} (hl : l ≠ []) (ha : a ∈ l)
    (hah : a ≠ l.head hl) :
    a ∈ l.tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [← List.cons_head_tail hl] at ha
  grind

name: Multiset.prod_eq_one_iff_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_eq_one_iff_eq_one [CommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedMonoid α]
    [CanonicallyOrderedMul α] {μ : Multiset α} (h0 : 1 ∉ μ) :
    μ.prod = 1 ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ prod_zero⟩
  rw [prod_eq_one_iff, eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  grind

name: Multiset.card_le_sum
statement: lemma card_le_sum (μ : Multiset ℕ) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) : μ.card ≤ μ.sum
proof:
:= by
  grind [card_nsmul_le_sum hp]

name: Multiset.sum_erase'
statement:
lemma sum_erase' [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α]
    [AddLeftReflectLE α] {μ : Multiset α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ μ) : (μ.erase a).sum = μ.sum - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_erase h]
  simp only [add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: Multiset.dedup_eq_range
statement:
lemma dedup_eq_range {M : Multiset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : ∀ n < m, n ∈ M) (h' : ∀ n ≥ m, n ∉ M) :
    M.dedup = range m
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [count_eq_of_nodup (nodup_dedup M), count_eq_of_nodup (nodup_range m)]
  grind [mem_dedup, mem_range]

name: Multiset.erase_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma erase_eq_zero_iff [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) :
    s.erase a = 0 ↔ s = 0 ∨ s = {a}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_toList s, coe_erase, coe_eq_zero, List.erase_eq_nil_iff, coe_eq_zero, coe_eq_singleton]

name: Multiset.erase_replicate
statement:
lemma erase_replicate [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} {a : α} :
    (replicate n a).erase a = replicate (n - 1) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.coe_replicate, Multiset.coe_erase, List.erase_replicate_self,
    Multiset.coe_replicate]

name: Multiset.replicate_toList
statement:
@[simp]
lemma replicate_toList {α : Type*} (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (replicate n a).toList = List.replicate n a
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.eq_replicate_iff, mem_replicate]

name: Multiset.replicate_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma replicate_eq_zero_iff {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) (a : α) :
    replicate n a = 0 ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [replicate]

name: Multiset.count_sort
statement:
lemma count_sort [DecidableEq α] {M : Multiset α} {x : α} :
    List.count x (M.sort r) = count x M
proof:
:= by
  simp [← coe_count]

name: Multiset.sort_perm_toList
statement: lemma sort_perm_toList (s : Multiset α) : (s.sort r).Perm s.toList
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← coe_toList s]
  rw [coe_sort]
  exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

name: Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_max
statement:
lemma sort_getElem_zero_eq_max {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {μ : Multiset α}
    (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.sort (· ≥ ·))[0]'(by simp [card_pos, ← toList_eq_nil, hμ]) =
    μ.toList.max hμ
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [List.max_eq_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_toList, ← mem_sort (· ≥ ·)]
  constructor
  · exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, _, hia⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
    rw [← hia]
    exact List.Pairwise.rel_get_of_le (pairwise_sort _ (· ≥ ·)) (by simp)

name: Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_min
statement:
lemma sort_getElem_zero_eq_min {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {μ : Multiset α}
    (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.sort (· ≤ ·))[0]'(by simp [card_pos, ← toList_eq_nil, hμ]) =
    μ.toList.min hμ
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [List.min_eq_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_toList, ← mem_sort (· ≤ ·)]
  constructor
  · exact List.getElem_mem _
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, _, hia⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
    rw [← hia]
    exact List.Pairwise.rel_get_of_le (pairwise_sort _ (· ≤ ·)) (by simp)

name: Multiset.sort_eq_replicate_iff
statement:
lemma sort_eq_replicate_iff {μ : Multiset α} {n : ℕ} {x : α} :
    (μ.sort r) = List.replicate n x ↔ μ = replicate n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.eq_replicate_iff, eq_replicate, length_sort, mem_sort]

name: Multiset.sort_sum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sort_sum (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] [IsTrans α r]
    [Std.Antisymm r] [Std.Total r] [AddCommMonoid α] (s : Multiset α) :
    (s.sort r).sum = s.sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_toList s, (sort_perm_toList s).sum_eq]

name: Multiset.sort_cons'
statement:
lemma sort_cons' {x : α} {R : α → α → Prop} {M : Multiset α} [DecidableRel R] [Std.Total R]
    [IsTrans α R] [Std.Antisymm R] (h : ∀ y ∈ M, R y x) :
    (x ::ₘ M).sort R = M.sort R ++ [x]
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (Multiset.pairwise_sort _ R) ?_ ?_
  · simpa [List.pairwise_append]
  · rw [← singleton_add, add_comm, ← coe_eq_coe, sort_eq, ← coe_add, coe_singleton, sort_eq]

name: sorted_pair
statement: lemma sorted_pair {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≥ b) : List.SortedGE [a, b]
proof:
:=
  List.Pairwise.sortedGE (by simp [h])

name: sorted_triple
statement:
lemma sorted_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    List.SortedGE [a, b, c]
proof: := List.Pairwise.sortedGE (by simp [hab, hbc, le_trans hbc hab])

name: sort_pair_ge
statement: lemma sort_pair_ge {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) : ({a, b} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≥ ·) = [a, b]
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) (sorted_pair hab).pairwise ?_
  exact List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) (by rfl)

name: sort_triple_le
statement:
lemma sort_triple_le {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    (({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≤ ·)) = [c, b, a]
proof:
:= by
  have habc : [a, b, c].reverse = [c, b, a] := by simp
  refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) ?_ ?_
  · rw [← habc, List.pairwise_reverse]
    exact (sorted_triple hab hbc).pairwise
  · refine List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) ?_
    rw [← habc, List.perm_reverse]

name: sort_triple_ge
statement:
lemma sort_triple_ge {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    (({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≥ ·)) = [a, b, c]
proof:
:=
  List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (List.pairwise_mergeSort' _ _) (sorted_triple hab hbc).pairwise <|
    List.Perm.trans (List.mergeSort_perm _ _) (by rfl)

name: max_triple
statement:
@[simp] lemma max_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).toList.max (by simp) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw! [← Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_max, sort_triple_ge hab hbc]
  rfl

name: min_triple
statement:
@[simp] lemma min_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).toList.min (by simp) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw! [← Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_min, sort_triple_le hab hbc]
  rfl

name: Multiset.count_fromCounts
statement:
lemma count_fromCounts {n : ℕ} (h : n < μ.card) :
    count n μ.fromCounts = (μ.sort (· ≥ ·))[n]'(by simp[h])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromCounts, ge_iff_le, count_sum', count_replicate]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (⟨n, by simp[h]⟩ :
    {n : ℕ | n < (μ.sort (· ≥ ·)).length}) (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · grind

name: Multiset.mem_fromCounts
statement:
lemma mem_fromCounts (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < μ.card) :
    n ∈ μ.fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_pos, count_fromCounts hn]
  refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ?_
  contrapose! h0
  rw [← h0]
  have hn' : n < (μ.sort (· ≥ ·)).length := by simp [hn]
  have hm := List.getElem_mem hn'
  rwa [Multiset.mem_sort] at hm

name: Multiset.notMem_fromCounts
statement:
lemma notMem_fromCounts (μ : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ μ.card) :
    n ∉ μ.fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_pos, fromCounts, count_sum']
  simp [count_replicate]
  lia

name: Multiset.mem_fromCounts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_fromCounts_iff {n : ℕ} (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    n ∈ μ.fromCounts ↔ n < μ.card
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · contrapose!
    exact notMem_fromCounts μ n
  · exact mem_fromCounts h0 n

name: Multiset.map_count_fromCounts
statement:
lemma map_count_fromCounts (μ : Multiset ℕ) :
    List.map (fun n ↦ count n μ.fromCounts) (List.range μ.card) = μ.sort (· ≥ ·)
proof:
:=
  List.ext_getElem (by simp) (by grind [count_fromCounts])

name: Multiset.fromCounts_dedup
statement: lemma fromCounts_dedup (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) : μ.fromCounts.dedup = range μ.card
proof:
:=
  dedup_eq_range (mem_fromCounts h0) (notMem_fromCounts μ)

name: Multiset.fromCounts_counts
statement: lemma fromCounts_counts (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) : μ.fromCounts.counts = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [counts, fromCounts_dedup h0, ← coe_range, map_coe, map_count_fromCounts]
  nth_rw 2 [← coe_toList μ]
  rw [coe_eq_coe]
  exact Multiset.sort_perm_toList _

name: Multiset.fromCounts_sorted
statement:
lemma fromCounts_sorted (μ : Multiset ℕ) : List.Pairwise (· ≥ ·) <|
    List.map (fun n => Multiset.count n μ.fromCounts) (List.range μ.card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_count_fromCounts]
  exact Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _

name: Multiset.fromCounts_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fromCounts_card : μ.fromCounts.card = μ.sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromCounts, ge_iff_le, card_sum, card_replicate]
  let e : {n : ℕ | n < (μ.sort (· ≥ ·)).length} → Fin (μ.sort (· ≥ ·)).length :=
    fun n ↦ ⟨n, n.2⟩
  rw [Fintype.sum_bijective e ?_ _ (fun n ↦ (μ.sort (· ≥ ·))[n.1]) ?_]
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_getElem, ← sum_coe]
    congr
    nth_rw 2 [← coe_toList μ]
    rw [coe_eq_coe]
    exact Multiset.sort_perm_toList _
  · constructor
    · intro n m
      grind
    · intro n
      use ⟨n.1, n.2⟩
  · simp [e]

name: Multiset.fromCounts_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma fromCounts_zero : fromCounts 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.bot_eq_zero, ← bot_counts_iff]
  refine fromCounts_counts ?_
  rw [bot_eq_zero]
  exact notMem_zero 0

name: Multiset.fromCounts_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma fromCounts_bot : fromCounts ⊥ = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: Multiset.ne_zero_of_fromCounts_ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_fromCounts_ne_zero (hμ : μ.fromCounts ≠ 0) : μ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hμ
  rw [hμ, fromCounts_zero]

name: Multiset.zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty
statement: lemma zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty (hμ : μ.fromCounts ≠ 0) : 0 ∈ μ.fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ n, n ∈ μ.fromCounts := by
    contrapose! hμ
    exact eq_zero_of_forall_notMem hμ
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hex
  rw [← count_pos, count_fromCounts] at hn
  · rw [← count_pos, count_fromCounts]
    · refine lt_of_lt_of_le hn ?_
      refine List.Pairwise.rel_get_of_le (Multiset.pairwise_sort _ (· ≥ ·)) ?_
      simp
    · rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, card_eq_zero]
      exact ne_zero_of_fromCounts_ne_zero hμ
  · rw [count_pos] at hn
    contrapose! hn
    exact notMem_fromCounts μ n hn

name: Multiset.fromCounts_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma fromCounts_eq_zero_iff (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    μ.fromCounts = 0 ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.bot_eq_zero, ← Multiset.bot_counts_iff, Multiset.fromCounts_counts h0]

name: Multiset.fromCounts_eq_nil_iff
statement:
lemma fromCounts_eq_nil_iff (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    μ.fromCounts.toList = [] ↔ μ.toList = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.toList_eq_nil, Multiset.toList_eq_nil, Multiset.fromCounts_eq_zero_iff μ h0]

name: Multiset.fromCounts_remove_card
statement:
lemma fromCounts_remove_card (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    (μ.fromCounts.remove 0).toFinset.card = μ.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · simp [hμ]
  · rw [remove_toFinset_card]
    · nth_rw 2 [← fromCounts_counts h0]
      rw [counts_card]
    · refine zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty ?_
      rwa [ne_eq, fromCounts_eq_zero_iff μ h0]

name: Multiset.cons_fromCounts_of_min
statement:
lemma cons_fromCounts_of_min (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ m ∈ μ, m ≥ n) :
    (n ::ₘ μ).fromCounts = μ.fromCounts + Multiset.replicate n (μ.card)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromCounts, ge_iff_le, Multiset.sort_cons' h]
  let n' : {m | m < ((n ::ₘ μ).sort (· ≥ ·)).length} :=
    ⟨((n ::ₘ μ).sort (· ≥ ·)).length - 1, by simp⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ n')]
  conv => lhs; rhs; simp [n']
  rw [add_left_inj]
  let e : (a : {m | m < ((n ::ₘ μ).sort (· ≥ ·)).length}) →
    (a ∈ (Finset.univ.erase n')) → {m | m < (μ.sort (· ≥ ·)).length} :=
    fun a ha ↦ ⟨a.1, by
      have ha' := a.2
      simp [n', ← Subtype.coe_inj] at ha ha'
      simp [Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne ha' ha]
      ⟩
  refine Finset.sum_bij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [e]
  · simp [e]
    grind
  · simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq, and_true, Subtype.exists, ge_iff_le,
      length_sort, card_cons, Order.lt_add_one_iff, forall_const, Subtype.forall, Subtype.mk.injEq,
      exists_prop, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, e]
    intro a ha
    use (by grind)
    simp [n']
    grind
  · simp only [Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Subtype.forall, ge_iff_le,
      length_sort, card_cons, Order.lt_add_one_iff, e]
    intro a ha ha'
    rw [List.getElem_append_left]

name: Multiset.erase_fromCounts_of_min
statement:
lemma erase_fromCounts_of_min (μ : Multiset ℕ) (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).fromCounts = μ.fromCounts.remove (μ.card - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : μ.toList.min hμ ∈ μ.toList := List.min_mem hμ
  rw [mem_toList] at hm
  nth_rw 3 [← cons_erase hm]
  rw [cons_fromCounts_of_min (μ.toList.min hμ), remove_add, remove_of_notMem, remove_replicate,
    empty_eq_zero, add_zero]
  · exact Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hm
  · exact notMem_fromCounts _ _ <| by simp [Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hm]
  · intro m hm
    exact List.min_le_of_mem <| by simp [mem_of_mem_erase hm]

name: Multiset.fromCounts_singleton
statement:
lemma fromCounts_singleton {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ({n} : Multiset ℕ).fromCounts = Multiset.replicate n 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 ∉ ({n} : Multiset ℕ) := by
    rw [mem_singleton]
    exact hn.symm
  simp only [fromCounts, ge_iff_le, sort_singleton, List.getElem_singleton]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, by simp⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _) (by simp; grind)]

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.entry_eq_zero_of_bot
statement: lemma entry_eq_zero_of_bot (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) {i j : ℕ} (h : γ = ⊥) : T i j = 0
proof:
:=
  T.zeros <| h ▸ notMem_bot _

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.col_le_entry
statement: lemma col_le_entry {i j : ℕ} (h : (i, j) ∈ γ) (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) : i ≤ T i j
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ i ih =>
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ih <| γ.up_left_mem (lt_add_one i).le (by rfl) h)
      <| T.col_strict (lt_add_one i) h

name: eq_highestWeight_ge_row
statement:
lemma eq_highestWeight_ge_row (h : T.content = (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens).fromCounts)
    (i₀ i j : ℕ) (hi : i ≥ i₀) : T i j = (highestWeight γ) i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi₀ : i₀ ≥ γ.colLen 0
  · have hij : (i, j) ∉ γ := by
      contrapose! hi₀
      rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen]
      exact γ.up_left_mem hi (Nat.zero_le j) hi₀
    rw [T.zeros hij, (highestWeight γ).zeros hij]
  · push Not at hi₀
    have hT : ∀ i' ≥ i₀ + 1, ∀ j', T i' j' = (highestWeight γ) i' j' := by
      intro i' hi' j'
      exact eq_highestWeight_ge_row h (i₀ + 1) i' j' hi'
    suffices T i₀ j = (highestWeight γ) i₀ j by
      by_cases hi₀' : i = i₀
      · rw [hi₀', this]
      · exact hT i (by lia) j
    by_cases hij : (i₀, j) ∈ γ
    · conv => rhs; simp only [highestWeight, DFunLike.coe, hij, reduceIte]
      refine le_antisymm ?_ (col_le_entry hij T)
      have hTc : T i₀ j < (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens).card := entry_lt_card h hij
      apply_fun Multiset.count (T i₀ j) at h
      contrapose! h
      refine ne_of_gt ?_
      rw [Multiset.count_fromCounts hTc]
      simp only [ge_iff_le, Multiset.coe_sort, List.mergeSort_eq_self _ γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise,
        get_rowLens, rowLen_eq_card, content, Multiset.count_map]
      refine Multiset.card_lt_card ?_
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
      · rw [Multiset.le_iff_subset (γ.row (T i₀ j)).nodup]
        intro x
        simp only [Finset.mem_val, mem_row_iff, Multiset.mem_filter, mem_cells, and_imp]
        intro hx hxT
        simp only [hx, true_and]
        specialize hT x.1 ?_ x.2
        · rwa [hxT]
        · simp only [highestWeight_apply, Prod.mk.eta, hx, ↓reduceIte] at hT
          rw [hT, hxT]
      · apply_fun Multiset.count (i₀, j)
        apply ne_of_lt at h
        simp [Multiset.count_eq_of_nodup (γ.cells.nodup), mem_row_iff, hij, h]
    · rw [T.zeros hij, (highestWeight γ).zeros hij]

name: rowLen_eq_filter
statement:
lemma rowLen_eq_filter {n : ℕ} : γ.rowLen n = (Multiset.filter
    (fun a ↦ n = if a ∈ γ then a.1 else 0) γ.cells.val).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowLen_eq_card, row, ← Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mpr
    <| Multiset.Nodup.filter _ γ.cells.nodup]
  congr
  ext x
  simp
  grind

name: content_highestWeight
statement:
lemma content_highestWeight : (highestWeight γ).content =
    (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens).fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  simp only [content, highestWeight_apply, Prod.mk.eta]
  ext n
  by_cases! hn : n < (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens).card
  · simp [Multiset.count_map, Multiset.count_fromCounts hn,
      List.mergeSort_eq_self _ γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise, ← rowLen_eq_filter]
  · simp only [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem (Multiset.notMem_fromCounts _ _ hn),
      Multiset.count_eq_zero, Multiset.mem_map, Finset.mem_val, mem_cells, Prod.exists, not_exists,
      not_and]
    intro i j hij
    simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte]
    contrapose! hij
    rw [Multiset.coe_card, length_rowLens] at hn
    rw [hij, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, rowLen_eq_zero (not_lt.mpr hn), not_lt]
    exact j.zero_le

name: eq_highestWeight_iff
statement:
lemma eq_highestWeight_iff : T = highestWeight γ ↔
    T.content = (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens).fromCounts
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ h ▸ content_highestWeight
  · intro h
    ext i j
    exact eq_highestWeight_ge_row h 0 i j (Nat.zero_le i)

name: mem_list_sym
statement:
lemma mem_list_sym {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} {L : List α} {xs : Sym α n}
    (h : xs.val.dedup ≤ Multiset.ofList L) : xs ∈ L.sym n
proof:
:= by
  unfold List.sym
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp [Sym.eq_nil_of_card_zero xs]
  by_cases hL : L = []
  · subst hL
    simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.coe_nil, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, Multiset.dedup_eq_zero] at h
    rw [← Multiset.card_eq_zero, Sym.card_coe] at h
    contradiction
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
  obtain ⟨x, L', hL⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hL
  subst hm hL
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
  · left
    obtain ⟨ys, hys⟩ := Sym.exists_cons_of_mem hx
    use ys
    constructor
    · refine mem_list_sym ?_
      rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
      intro a
      simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.count_dedup, Sym.mem_coe, Multiset.coe_count]
      split_ifs with ha
      · rw [List.one_le_count_iff]
        have ha' : a ∈ xs := by
          rw [hys]
          simp [ha]
        rw [Multiset.le_iff_count] at h
        specialize h a
        simpa [ha'] using h
      · exact Nat.zero_le _
    · exact hys.symm
  · right
    refine mem_list_sym ?_
    rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
    intro a
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.count_dedup,
      Sym.mem_coe, Multiset.coe_count]
    split_ifs with ha
    · have hax : a ≠ x := by
        contrapose! hx
        exact hx ▸ ha
      rw [List.one_le_count_iff]
      rw [Multiset.le_iff_count] at h
      specialize h a
      simpa [ha, hax] using h
    · exact Nat.zero_le _
  termination_by n + L.length

name: lt_sub_sort_length
statement:
lemma lt_sub_sort_length {content row2 : Multiset ℕ} {i : ℕ} (hrc : row2 ≤ content)
    (hr0 : γ.rowLen 0 = content.card - row2.card) (hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = row2.card)
    (hi : i < row2.card) : i < ((content - row2).sort (· ≤ ·)).length
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.card_sub hrc, ← hr0]
  grind [γ.rowLen_anti 0 1 zero_le_one]

name: twoRow_content
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoRow_content {γ : YoungDiagram} {content row2 : Multiset ℕ}
    (hr0 : γ.rowLen 0 = content.card - row2.card)
    (hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = row2.card) (hc0 : γ.colLen 0 = 2)
    (hrc : row2 ≤ content)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, (hi : i < row2.card) → (∀ r ∈ row2, r >
      ((content - row2).sort (· ≤ ·))[i]'(lt_sub_sort_length hrc hr0 hr1 hi))) :
    (twoRowTableau hr0 hr1 hc0 hrc h).content = content
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : γ.cells = γ.row 0 ∪ γ.row 1 := by
    rw [cells_eq_biUnion_row, γ.length_rowLens, hc0]
    ext x
    simp
  simp only [SemistandardYoungTableau.content, hγ, Finset.union_val]
  rw [← Multiset.add_eq_union_iff_disjoint.mpr, Multiset.map_add, ← map_row, ← map_row]
  · simp only [DFunLike.coe, twoRowTableau, Multiset.length_sort, Multiset.card_sub hrc,
    to_fun_eq_coe, true_and, zero_ne_one, false_and, ↓reduceDIte, Multiset.map_coe, one_ne_zero,
    Multiset.coe_add]
    rw [hr0, hr1]
    simp only [Fin.is_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
    have hms : List.map (fun x ↦ ((content - row2).sort (· ≤ ·))[x.1]'
        (by simp [x.2, Multiset.card_sub hrc])) (List.finRange (content.card - row2.card)) =
        ((content - row2).sort (· ≤ ·)) := by
      refine List.ext_getElem ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp [Multiset.card_sub hrc]
    rw [hms]
    have hpsub : row2.card = (row2.sort (· ≤ ·)).length := by simp
    rw! [hpsub]
    simp_rw [List.map_getElem_finRange, ← Multiset.coe_add, Multiset.sort_eq,
      tsub_add_cancel_of_le hrc]
  · rw [Finset.disjoint_val]
    exact disjoint_row zero_ne_one

name: map_twoRow_eq_row2_sub_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val = (γ.row 1).val by rfl,
    ← map_row (fun i j ↦ (twoRowTableau hr0 hr1 hc0 hrc h) i j - 1), Multiset.map_coe]
  conv => rhs; rw [← Multiset.sort_eq row2 (· ≤ ·), Multiset.map_coe]
  congr 1
  refine List.ext_get ?_ ?_
  · simp [hr1]
  · simp only [DFunLike.coe, twoRowTableau, Multiset.length_sort, to_fun_eq_coe, one_ne_zero,
      false_and, ↓reduceDIte, true_and, List.length_map, List.length_finRange, ↓dreduceDIte,
      List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_finRange, Fin.cast_mk]
    intro i h₁ h₂
    simp [h₂]

name: sorted_le_of_exists_multiset
statement:
lemma sorted_le_of_exists_multiset (L : List ℕ) (hL : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < L.length) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∃ S : Multiset ℕ, S ≤ Multiset.ofList L ∧ S.card ≥ i + 1 ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, s ≤ n) :
    L[i]'hi ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard, hn⟩ := h
    apply Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp at hcard
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcard
    specialize hn a ha
    refine le_trans ?_ hn
    apply Multiset.mem_of_le hS at ha
    rw [Multiset.mem_coe] at ha
    obtain ⟨i, ⟨hi, hia⟩⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
    rw [← hia]
    by_cases! hi0' : i = 0
    · subst hi0'
      rfl
    exact List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hL _ _ _ _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0')
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard, hn⟩ := h
    have hlt : (L.tail)[i-1]'(by rw [List.length_tail]; lia) = L[i] := by
      simp_rw [List.getElem_tail, show i - 1 + 1 = i by lia]
    rw [← hlt]
    refine sorted_le_of_exists_multiset L.tail (List.Pairwise.tail hL) (i - 1) _ n ?_
    use (S.erase L[0])
    constructor
    · rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
      intro a
      apply Multiset.count_le_of_le a at hS
      by_cases ha : a = L[0]
      · rw [← ha, Multiset.count_erase_self, Multiset.coe_count]
        rw [Multiset.coe_count] at hS
        have hct : List.count a L - 1 ≤ List.count a L.tail := List.le_count_tail
        lia
      · rw [Multiset.count_erase_of_ne ha, Multiset.coe_count, List.count_tail]
        rw [Multiset.coe_count] at hS
        suffices ¬ L.head? == some a by simpa [this]
        simp only [List.head?, beq_iff_eq]
        suffices L = L[0] :: L.tail by
          rw [this]
          simp only [Option.some.injEq, ne_eq]
          push Not at ha
          exact ha.symm
        have hL0 : L ≠ [] := by
          rw [ne_eq, List.eq_nil_iff_length_eq_zero]
          lia
        exact (List.head_eq_getElem_zero hL0) ▸ (List.cons_head_tail hL0).symm
    constructor
    · rw [Multiset.card_erase_eq_ite, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
      grind
    · intro s hs
      exact hn s <| Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hs

name: eq_of_map_sub_one_filter_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_map_sub_one_filter_eq {γ : YoungDiagram} {μ : Multiset ℕ}
    (hc : γ.colLen 0 = 2)
    (T₁ : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hT₁ : T₁ ∈ SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ)
    (T₂ : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hT₂ : T₂ ∈ SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ)
    (h : Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T₁ x.1 x.2 - 1) (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val) =
    Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T₂ x.1 x.2 - 1) (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val)) :
    T₁ = T₂
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_missing_row T₁ T₂ ?_ 0 ?_
  · rw [hT₁, hT₂]
  · intro i hi j
    by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ γ
    · refine eq_entry_of_map_row T₁ T₂ i j ?_
      have hi0 : ∀ i j : ℕ, (i, j) ∈ γ → i ≠ 0 → i = 1 := by
        intro i j hij hi
        rw [mem_iff_lt_colLen] at hij
        apply lt_of_le_of_lt' (γ.colLen_anti 0 j (Nat.zero_le j)) at hij
        lia
      specialize hi0 i j hij hi
      rw [hi0, row]
      ext a
      by_cases ha : a = 0
      · suffices ∀ T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ, Multiset.count a (Multiset.map
          (fun x : ℕ × ℕ ↦ T x.1 x.2) {c ∈ γ.cells | c.1 = 1}.val) = 0 by rw [this T₁, this T₂]
        intro T
        simp only [ha, Finset.filter_val, Multiset.count_eq_zero, Multiset.mem_map,
          Multiset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_val, mem_cells, Prod.exists, not_exists, not_and,
          and_imp]
        intro i j hij hi
        suffices T i j ≥ i by lia
        exact col_le_entry hij T
      simp only [Finset.filter_val, Multiset.count_map, Multiset.filter_filter]
      simp only [Multiset.ext, Multiset.count_map, Multiset.filter_filter] at h
      specialize h (a - 1)
      suffices ∀ T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ,
          (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ a = T x.1 x.2 ∧ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val).card =
          (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ a - 1 = T x.1 x.2 - 1 ∧ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val).card by
        rw [this T₁, this T₂, h]
      clear h hT₁ T₁ hT₂ T₂
      intro T
      rw [
        ← Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mpr <| Multiset.Nodup.filter _ γ.cells.nodup,
        ← Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mpr <| Multiset.Nodup.filter _ γ.cells.nodup]
      refine Finset.card_bijective id Function.bijective_id ?_
      intro x
      simp only [Multiset.toFinset_filter, Finset.val_toFinset, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells,
        id_eq, and_congr_right_iff, and_congr_left_iff]
      intro hx hx1
      suffices T x.1 x.2 ≥ 1 by lia
      exact hx1 ▸ col_le_entry hx T
    · rw [T₁.zeros hij, T₂.zeros hij]

name: exists_ssytwc_map_sub_one_filter
statement:
lemma exists_ssytwc_map_sub_one_filter {γ : YoungDiagram} {n p : ℕ} {μ : Multiset ℕ}
    (hγ : γ.rowLens = [n - p, p]) (hcs : γ.card = μ.sum) (hμ : μ.toList ≠ [])
    (hp : p ≤ μ.toList.min hμ)
    (L : Sym ℕ p) (hL : L ∈ List.sym p (List.range (μ.card - 1))) :
    ∃ T ∈ SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ,
    Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T x.1 x.2 - 1) (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val) =
    L.toMultiset
proof:
:= by
  have hμc : μ.card ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, Multiset.card_eq_zero, ← Multiset.toList_eq_nil]
  have hr0 : γ.rowLen 0 = n - p := by simp [← get_rowLens, hγ]
  have hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = p := by simp [← get_rowLens, hγ]
  have hc0 : γ.colLen 0 = 2 := by simp [← length_rowLens, hγ]
  let M := Multiset.map (· + 1) L.val
  have hM : M ≤ μ.fromCounts := by
    rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
    intro a
    by_cases ha : a < μ.card
    · simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.count_map, Multiset.count_fromCounts ha, ge_iff_le, M]
      have hmf : (Multiset.filter (fun b ↦ a = b + 1) L.val).card ≤ p := by
        have hLp : p = L.val.card := by simp
        conv => rhs; rw [hLp]
        exact Multiset.card_le_card (by simp)
      refine le_trans hmf <| le_trans hp <| List.min_le_of_mem ?_
      rw [Multiset.mem_toList, ← Multiset.mem_sort (· ≥ ·)]
      exact List.getElem_mem _
    · suffices Multiset.count a M = 0 by simp [this]
      simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.count_eq_zero, Multiset.mem_map, Sym.mem_coe,
        not_exists, not_and, M]
      intro x hx
      suffices x < μ.card - 1 by lia
      apply List.mem_of_mem_of_mem_sym hx at hL
      rwa [List.mem_range] at hL
  have hnp : p ≤ n - p := by
    rw [← hr0, ← hr1]
    exact γ.rowLen_anti 0 1 zero_le_one
  have hμn : μ.fromCounts.card = n := by
    simp [← hcs, card_eq_sum_rowLens, hγ]
    lia
  have hMp : M.card = p := by simp [M]
  have hr0' : γ.rowLen 0 = μ.fromCounts.card - M.card := by rw [hμn, hMp, hr0]
  use (twoRowTableau hr0' (hMp ▸ hr1) hc0 hM ?_)
  swap
  · intro i hi r hr
    simp [M] at hr
    suffices ((μ.fromCounts - M).sort (· ≤ ·))[i]'(by
        simp [Multiset.card_sub hM, hMp, hμn]; lia) = 0 by lia
    rw [← Nat.le_zero]
    refine sorted_le_of_exists_multiset _ (Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _) i _ 0 ?_
    use Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ 0 = x) (μ.fromCounts - M)
    constructor
    · rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
      intro a
      rw [Multiset.coe_count, Multiset.count_sort]
      exact Multiset.count_le_of_le a (Multiset.filter_le _ _)
    constructor
    · rw [← Multiset.count_eq_card_filter_eq, Multiset.count_sub,
        Multiset.count_fromCounts (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hμc),
        show Multiset.count 0 M = 0 by simp [M]]
      rw [Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_max hμ]
      have hmm := List.min_le_of_mem (List.max_mem hμ)
      lia
    · intro s
      rw [Multiset.mem_filter]
      lia
  constructor
  · simp [SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent]
  · simp [map_twoRow_eq_row2_sub_one, M]

name: map_sub_one_filter_mem_sym
statement:
lemma map_sub_one_filter_mem_sym {γ : YoungDiagram} {μ : Multiset ℕ} {p : ℕ}
    (hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = p) (h0 : 0 ∉ μ)
    (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) (hT : T ∈ SemistandardYoungTableauWithContent γ μ) :
    ⟨Multiset.map (fun x ↦ T x.1 x.2 - 1) (Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val),
      by
      simp only [Multiset.card_map]
      rw [show Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val = (γ.row 1).val by rfl,
        Finset.card_val, ← γ.rowLen_eq_card, hr1]⟩ ∈
    List.sym p (List.range (μ.card - 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_list_sym ?_
  simp only
  rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
  intro a
  simp only [Multiset.count_dedup, Multiset.mem_map, Multiset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_val, mem_cells, Prod.exists, ↓existsAndEq, and_true, Multiset.coe_count,
    List.count_range]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rename_i ham ha
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, Multiset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_val, mem_cells, Prod.exists,
    ↓existsAndEq, and_true] at ham
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := ham
  subst hia
  have := col_le_entry hi T
  apply T.mem_content_of_mem at hi
  rw [hT, Multiset.mem_fromCounts_iff h0] at hi
  lia

name: kostka_two_rows
statement:
theorem kostka_two_rows (h2 : γ.rowLens = [n - p, p]) (h : γ.card = μ.sum) (hμ : μ.toList ≠ [])
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hp : p ≤ μ.toList.min hμ) :
    kostkaNumber γ μ = (p + μ.card - 2).choose p
proof:
:= by
  have hμc : μ.card ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, Multiset.card_eq_zero, ← Multiset.toList_eq_nil]
  have hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = p := by simp [← get_rowLens, h2]
  have hc0 : γ.colLen 0 = 2 := by simp [← length_rowLens, h2]
  rw [show p + μ.card - 2 = (μ.card - 1) + p - 1 by lia, ← Nat.multichoose_eq,
    kostka_eq_card_SSYTWithContent,
    ← show (List.range (μ.card - 1)).length = μ.card - 1 by exact List.length_range,
    ← List.length_sym, ← Multiset.coe_card,
    ← Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup <| Multiset.coe_nodup.mpr <|
      List.Nodup.sym _ List.nodup_range,
    Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset (finite_SSYTWithContent γ μ)]
  let e : (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) →
    (hT : T ∈ Set.Finite.toFinset (finite_SSYTWithContent γ μ)) → Sym ℕ p :=
    fun T hT ↦ ⟨Multiset.map (fun (i, j) => (T i j) - 1) (Finset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1)
      (γ.cells)).val, by
      simp only [Finset.filter_val, Multiset.card_map]
      rw [show Multiset.filter (fun x ↦ x.1 = 1) γ.cells.val = (γ.row 1).val by rfl,
        Finset.card_val, ← γ.rowLen_eq_card, hr1]
      ⟩
  refine Finset.card_bij e ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Set.toFinite_toFinset, Set.mem_toFinset, List.toFinset_coe, Finset.filter_val,
      List.mem_toFinset, e]
    exact map_sub_one_filter_mem_sym hr1 h0
  · simp only [Set.toFinite_toFinset, Set.mem_toFinset, Finset.filter_val, ← Sym.coe_inj,
      Sym.coe_mk, e]
    exact eq_of_map_sub_one_filter_eq hc0
  · simp only [List.toFinset_coe, List.mem_toFinset, Finset.filter_val, Set.toFinite_toFinset,
      Set.mem_toFinset, exists_prop, e, ← Sym.coe_inj, Sym.coe_mk]
    exact exists_ssytwc_map_sub_one_filter h2 h hμ hp

name: content_horizontalSSYT
statement:
lemma content_horizontalSSYT (μ : Multiset ℕ) :
    (horizontalSSYT μ).content = μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold content
  let γ := horizontalDiagram μ.card
  have hγ : γ.cells = (γ.row 0) := by
    ext i
    simp [γ, mem_row_iff]
    grind
  rw [hγ, ← map_row, Multiset.map_coe, ← List.ofFn_eq_map]
  conv => rhs; rw [← Multiset.coe_toList μ]
  suffices (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (γ.rowLen 0) ↦ (horizontalSSYT μ) 0 k)) =
      μ.sort (· ≤ ·) by
    rw [this, Multiset.coe_eq_coe]
    exact Multiset.sort_perm_toList _
  have hc : γ.rowLen 0 = μ.card := by simp [rowLen_eq_card, ← hγ, γ]
  have hc2 : μ.card = (μ.sort (· ≤ ·)).length := by simp
  simp only [hc, DFunLike.coe, horizontalSSYT, Fin.val_cast, to_fun_eq_coe, Fin.is_lt,
    and_self, ↓reduceDIte]
  conv => rhs; rw [← List.ofFn_getElem (xs := μ.sort (· ≤ ·))]
  congr
  exact (Fin.heq_fun_iff hc2).mpr (congrFun rfl)

name: eq_horizontalSSYT_content
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n = T.content.card := by rw [content_card_eq_card, h, horizontalDiagram_card]
  rw [hn] at h
  refine eq_of_missing_row'' T (horizontalSSYT (T.content)) h ?_ 0 ?_
  · rw [content_horizontalSSYT]
  · intro i hi j
    rw [T.zeros, (horizontalSSYT T.content).zeros]
    · simp [hi]
    · rw [h]
      simp [hi]

name: eq_horizontalSSYT_content'
proof:
:=
  eq_horizontalSSYT_content T rfl

name: card_of_exists_aux
statement:
lemma card_of_exists_aux {M : Multiset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : ∃ x ∈ M, x < m) :
    M.card + 1 ≥ 2
proof:
:= by
  suffices M.card ≠ 0 by lia
  rw [ne_eq, Multiset.card_eq_zero, Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  grind

name: hookSSYT_entry10
statement:
@[simp] lemma hookSSYT_entry10 {M : Multiset ℕ} {m : ℕ} {h : ∃ x ∈ M, x < m} :
    (hookSSYT M m h) 1 0 = m
proof:
:= by
