  rw [← Set.coe_toFinset {p : γ.cornerHookPath | p.1.horizontal = s ∧ p.1.vertical = t ∧
      p.1.path.getLast p.1.ne_nil = x}, PMF.toMeasure_apply_finset, Set.toFinset_setOf]
  simp only [pmf, pmf_fun', DFunLike.coe]
  rw [ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij (fun p : γ.cornerHookPath ↦ p.1) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p
    simp
    grind
  · simp

name: pab_empty_left_eq
statement:
lemma pab_empty_left_eq {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) (t : Finset ℕ)
    (htx : t ∈ (Finset.range x.2).powerset) :
    pab hx ∅ t = 1 / γ.card * ∏ j ∈ t, 1 / (γ.hookLength (x.1, j) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, Finset.coe_empty, setOf_horizontal_empty_eq_down hx htx,
    Finsupp.set_indicator_singleton, Finsupp.univ_sum_single_apply]
  rw [pmf_downHookPath hx htx]

name: pab_empty_right_eq
statement:
lemma pab_empty_right_eq {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) (s : Finset ℕ)
    (hsx : s ∈ (Finset.range x.1).powerset) :
    pab hx s ∅ = 1 / γ.card * ∏ i ∈ s, 1 / (γ.hookLength (i, x.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, Finset.coe_empty, setOf_vertical_empty_eq_left hx hsx,
    Finsupp.set_indicator_singleton, Finsupp.univ_sum_single_apply]
  rw [pmf_leftHookPath hx hsx]

name: pab_recursion
statement:
lemma pab_recursion {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) {s t : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : s ∈ (Finset.range x.1).powerset) (ht : t ∈ (Finset.range x.2).powerset)
    (hs0 : s.Nonempty) (ht0 : t.Nonempty) :
    pab hx s t =
    1 / (γ.hookLength (s.min' hs0, t.min' ht0) - 1) *
    (pab hx (s.erase (s.min' hs0)) t + pab hx s (t.erase (t.min' ht0)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pab_eq, ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
  classical rw [← Finset.sum_union, Finset.filter_union_right, Finset.mul_sum]
  · refine Finset.sum_nbij (fun p ↦ p.tail) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.coe_erase, and_imp]
      intro p hps hpt hpx
      have hp1 : p.path.length > 1 := length_gt_one_of_horz_nonempty hps hs0
      by_cases! hh : p.path[1].1 = s.min' hs0
      · right
        simp [path_tail p hp1, hpx, horizontal_tail_of_eq_min' hp1 hps hs0 hh,
          vertical_tail_of_ne_min' hp1 hpt ht0 ((eq_min'_iff_ne_min' hp1 hps hpt hs0 ht0).mp hh)]
      · left
        have hv : p.path[1].2 = t.min' ht0 := by
          rwa [ne_eq, eq_min'_iff_ne_min' hp1 hps hpt hs0 ht0, not_not] at hh
        simp [path_tail p hp1, hpx, horizontal_tail_of_ne_min' hp1 hps hs0 hh,
          vertical_tail_of_eq_min' hp1 hpt ht0 hv]
    · intro p
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq, and_imp]
      intro hps hpt hpx q hqs hqt hqx hpq
      have hp1 : p.path.length > 1 := length_gt_one_of_horz_nonempty hps hs0
      have hq1 : q.path.length > 1 := length_gt_one_of_horz_nonempty hqs hs0
      ext1
      apply_fun hookPath.path at hpq
      rw [path_tail p hp1, path_tail q hq1] at hpq
      rw [← List.cons_head_tail p.ne_nil, ← List.cons_head_tail q.ne_nil, hpq,
        head_eq_horz_vert_min hps hpt hs0 ht0, head_eq_horz_vert_min hqs hqt hs0 ht0]
    · intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.coe_erase, Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      have hst : p.path.head p.ne_nil ∈ γ.hook (s.min' hs0, t.min' ht0) := by
        simp only [hook, ge_iff_le, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells]
        constructor
        · rw [← mem_cells]
          exact mem_cells_of_mem_hookPath (List.head_mem p.ne_nil)
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · right
          rw [← Finset.coe_singleton, ← Finset.coe_sdiff] at hp
          simp only [head_snd_eq_vert_min hp.2.1 ht0, and_true]
          by_cases! hs0' : (s \ {s.min' hs0}).Nonempty
          · rw [head_fst_eq_horz_min hp.1 hs0']
            simp only [Finset.le_min'_iff, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton, and_imp]
            intro y hy _
            exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hy
          · simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset, Finset.subset_singleton_iff,
              Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hs0, false_or] at hs0'
            suffices (p.path.head p.ne_nil).1 = x.1 by grind
            rw [Prod.ext_iff] at hp
            rw [← hp.2.2.1]
            apply And.left at hp
            conv at hp => rhs; rhs; lhs; rw [hs0']
            simp only [hookPath.horizontal, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right,
              sdiff_self, Finset.bot_eq_empty, Finset.coe_empty, Set.sdiff_eq_empty,
              Set.subset_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index] at hp
            exact hp (p.path.head p.ne_nil).1 (p.path.head p.ne_nil).2 (List.head_mem _)
        · left
          rw [← Finset.coe_singleton, ← Finset.coe_sdiff] at hp
          simp only [head_fst_eq_horz_min hp.1 hs0, true_and]
          by_cases! ht0' : (t \ {t.min' ht0}).Nonempty
          · rw [head_snd_eq_vert_min hp.2.1 ht0']
            simp only [Finset.le_min'_iff, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton, and_imp]
            intro y hy _
            exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hy
          · simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset, Finset.subset_singleton_iff,
              Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp ht0, false_or] at ht0'
            suffices (p.path.head p.ne_nil).2 = x.2 by grind
            rw [Prod.ext_iff] at hp
            rw [← hp.2.2.2]
            apply And.right at hp; apply And.left at hp
            conv at hp => rhs; rhs; lhs; rw [ht0']
            simp only [Prod.exists, exists_eq_right, sdiff_self, Finset.bot_eq_empty,
              Finset.coe_empty, Set.sdiff_eq_empty, Set.subset_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
              forall_exists_index] at hp
            exact hp (p.path.head p.ne_nil).2 (p.path.head p.ne_nil).1 (List.head_mem _)
      have hst' : (s.min' hs0, t.min' ht0) ≠ p.path.head p.ne_nil := by
        rw [ne_eq, Prod.ext_iff, not_and_or]
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · left
          by_cases! hh : (p.path.head p.ne_nil).1 ∈ p.horizontal
          · grind
          · simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right,
              Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_and, Decidable.not_not,
              forall_exists_index] at hh
            specialize hh (p.path.head p.ne_nil).2 (List.head_mem _)
            rw [hh, hp.2.2]
            refine ne_of_lt ?_
            obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs0
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.min'_le _ _ ha) (by grind)
        · right
          by_cases! hv : (p.path.head p.ne_nil).2 ∈ p.vertical
          · grind
          · simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Prod.exists, exists_eq_right,
              Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_and, Decidable.not_not,
              forall_exists_index] at hv
            specialize hv (p.path.head p.ne_nil).1 (List.head_mem _)
            rw [hv, hp.2.2]
            refine ne_of_lt ?_
            obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ht0
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.min'_le _ _ ha) (by grind)
      use p.cons hst hst'
      constructor
      constructor
      · rcases hp with hp | hp
        · rw [cons_horizontal_of_mem_vertical, hp.1, Set.sdiff_union_of_subset]
          · simp [Finset.min'_mem]
          · simp [hp.2.1, Finset.min'_mem]
        · rw [cons_horizontal_of_mem_horizontal, hp.1]
          simp [hp.1, Finset.min'_mem]
      constructor
      · rcases hp with hp | hp
        · rw [cons_vertical_of_mem_vertical, hp.2.1]
          simp [hp.2.1, Finset.min'_mem]
        · rw [cons_vertical_of_mem_horizontal, hp.2.1, Set.sdiff_union_of_subset]
          · simp [Finset.min'_mem]
          · simp [hp.1, Finset.min'_mem]
      · rw [getLast_cons]
        grind
      · exact tail_cons p hst hst'
    · intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
      have hp1 : p.path.length > 1 := length_gt_one_of_horz_nonempty hp.1 hs0
      have hpc : p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners := hp.2.2 ▸ hx
      rw [pmf_fun_eq_div_mul_tail p hp1 hpc, ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_div]
      · rw [head_eq_horz_vert_min hp.1 hp.2.1 hs0 ht0]
        rfl
      · exact hookLength_head_sub_one_ne_zero hp1 hpc
  · intro S hS hS' p hp
    have hp' := hS' hp
    apply hS at hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp hp'
    apply And.left at hp
    rw [hp'.1] at hp
    have hs : s ≠ s.erase (s.min' hs0) := (Finset.erase_ne_self.mpr (Finset.min'_mem s hs0)).symm
    rw [Finset.coe_inj] at hp
    contradiction

name: col_sub_corner
statement:
lemma col_sub_corner {w : ℕ × ℕ} (hw : w ∈ γ.corners) {j : ℕ} :
    (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).col j =
    if j = w.2 then (γ.col j).erase (w.1, j) else γ.col j
proof:
:= by
  have hw' := hw
  simp [corners] at hw'
  split_ifs with hwj
  · subst hwj
    ext y
    simp [col, mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
    by_cases hwy : w.1 = y.1
    · simp [hwy]
      grind
    · simp [hwy, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
      grind
  · ext y
    simp only [col, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw)),
      and_congr_left_iff]
    intro hyj
    by_cases! hyw : y.1 = w.1
    · simp only [hyw, rowLen'_eq_rowLen, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
      rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
      lia
    · simp [hyw, rowLen'_eq_rowLen, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen]

name: hookLength_sub_of_antiHook
statement:
lemma hookLength_sub_of_antiHook {x w : ℕ × ℕ} (hw : w ∈ γ.corners)
    (hx : x ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).cells)
    (h : x.1 = w.1 ∨ x.2 = w.2) :
    (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).hookLength x = γ.hookLength x - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hookLength_def, ← rowLen'_eq_rowLen, ge_iff_le, sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw),
    implies_true, sub_rowLen', Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  have hw' := hw
  simp only [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hw'
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hr2 : x.2 + 1 ≤ w.2 := by
      simp [mem_cells, mem_sub x (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw)), h, rowLen'_eq_rowLen] at hx
      lia
    have hxw : x.2 ≠ w.2 := by lia
    simp [h, colLen_eq_card, col_sub_corner hw, hxw, rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
    lia
  · have hxw : x.1 < w.1 := by
      rw [mem_cells, mem_sub x (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw)), h, rowLen'_eq_rowLen] at hx
      have hwx : w.1 ≠ x.1 := by
        contrapose! hx
        simp [hx, hw'.2.1]
      suffices x.1 < w.1 + 1 by lia
      simp [hwx, ← h] at hx
      rwa [hw'.2.2, ← h, ← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
    have hc : (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).colLen x.2 = γ.colLen x.2 - 1 := by
      have hwc : w ∈ γ.col w.2 := by simp [mem_col_iff, hw'.1]
      simp [colLen_eq_card, col_sub_corner hw, h, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hwc]
    rw [hc]
    simp [h, hxw.ne]
    lia

name: hookLength_sub_of_not_antiHook
statement:
lemma hookLength_sub_of_not_antiHook {x w : ℕ × ℕ} (hw : w ∈ γ.corners)
    (h : ¬(x.1 = w.1 ∨ x.2 = w.2)) :
    (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).hookLength x = γ.hookLength x
proof:
:= by
  simp at h
  simp [hookLength_def, ← rowLen'_eq_rowLen, sub_rowLen' (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hw)),
    colLen_eq_card, col_sub_corner hw, h.1, h.2]

name: hookLength_sub_ite
statement:
lemma hookLength_sub_ite {x w : ℕ × ℕ} (hw : w ∈ γ.corners)
    (hx : x ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).cells) :
    ((γ.sub (Finsupp.single w.1 1)).hookLength x : ℝ≥0∞) =
    (if x.1 = w.1 ∨ x.2 = w.2 then γ.hookLength x - 1 else γ.hookLength x : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact_mod_cast hookLength_sub_of_antiHook hw hx h
  · exact_mod_cast hookLength_sub_of_not_antiHook hw h

name: prod_sub_hookLength
statement:
lemma prod_sub_hookLength {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells,
    ((γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞) =
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells,
    ((if i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2 then γ.hookLength i - 1 else γ.hookLength i) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_congr (by rfl) (by grind [hookLength_sub_ite])

name: prod_hookLength_eq_sub
statement:
lemma prod_hookLength_eq_sub {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∏ i ∈ γ.cells with i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2, (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞) =
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2,
    (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ γ := by
    simp only [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hx
    exact hx.1
  have h : (γ.hookLength x : ℝ≥0∞) = 1 := by
    rw [γ.mem_corners_iff_hookLength_eq_one hx'] at hx
    exact_mod_cast hx
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase _ (f := fun w ↦ (γ.hookLength w : ℝ≥0∞)) h]
  congr
  ext z
  simp [mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
  by_cases hxz : x.1 = z.1
  · simp [hxz]
    simp [corners] at hx
    grind [mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
  · push Not at hxz
    simp [hxz.symm, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen, Prod.ext_iff]

name: prod_hookLength_not_eq_sub
statement:
lemma prod_hookLength_not_eq_sub {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∏ i ∈ γ.cells with ¬(i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2), (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞) =
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with ¬(i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2),
    (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp [mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
  grind [mem_iff_lt_rowLen]

name: ENNReal.mul_inv_sub_one
statement:
lemma ENNReal.mul_inv_sub_one {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : a ≥ 1) (hat : a ≠ ⊤) :
    a * (a - 1)⁻¹ = 1 + (a - 1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  suffices (a * (a - 1)⁻¹).HolderConjugate a by exact ENNReal.HolderConjugate.conj_eq
  rw [ENNReal.holderConjugate_iff, ENNReal.mul_inv, inv_inv]
  · nth_rw 2 [← mul_one a⁻¹]
    rw [← left_distrib, tsub_add_cancel_of_le ha, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by positivity) hat]
  · left
    positivity
  · left
    exact hat

name: prod_range_hookLength
statement:
lemma prod_range_hookLength {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range x.1,
    (1 + 1 / (γ.hookLength (i, x.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)) =
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with i.2 = x.2,
    (γ.hookLength i * (γ.hookLength i - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := hx
  simp [corners] at hx'
  symm
  let e : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ i.1
  refine Finset.prod_nbij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)),
      rowLen'_eq_rowLen, Finset.mem_range, and_imp, Prod.forall, e]
    intro a
    by_cases! hax : a = x.1
    · intro b
      simp [hax]
      lia
    · simp only [ne_eq, hax, not_false_eq_true, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne, tsub_zero]
      intro b hb
      rw [← mem_iff_lt_rowLen, mem_iff_lt_colLen] at hb
      lia
  · intro y
    simp [e]
    grind
  · intro b
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, Finset.coe_filter, mem_cells,
      mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen, Set.mem_image,
      Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, ↓existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_right, e]
    intro hb
    simp [hb.ne, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen, mem_iff_lt_colLen]
    lia
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, one_div, and_imp, Prod.forall, e]
    intro i j _ hj
    subst hj
    rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_sub_one]
    · grind [hookLength_ne_zero, Nat.one_le_cast]
    · simp

name: prod_range_hookLength'
statement:
lemma prod_range_hookLength' {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range x.2,
    (1 + 1 / (γ.hookLength (x.1, i) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)) =
    ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with i.1 = x.1,
    (γ.hookLength i * (γ.hookLength i - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := hx
  simp [corners] at hx'
  symm
  let e : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ i.2
  refine Finset.prod_nbij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)),
      rowLen'_eq_rowLen, Finset.mem_range, and_imp, Prod.forall, e]
    intro a
    by_cases! hax : a = x.1
    · intro b
      simp [hax]
      lia
    · simp only [ne_eq, hax, not_false_eq_true, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne, tsub_zero]
      intro b hb
      rw [← mem_iff_lt_rowLen, mem_iff_lt_colLen] at hb
      lia
  · intro y
    simp [e]
    grind
  · intro b
    simp [e, mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
    lia
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, one_div, and_imp, Prod.forall, e]
    intro i j _ hj
    subst hj
    rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_sub_one]
    · grind [hookLength_ne_zero, Nat.one_le_cast]
    · simp

name: F_div_eq_prod_mul_prod
statement:
lemma F_div_eq_prod_mul_prod {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    F (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)) / F γ = 1 / γ.card *
    ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range x.1, (1 + 1 / (γ.hookLength (i, x.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞))) *
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range x.2, (1 + 1 / (γ.hookLength (x.1, j) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞))))
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : γ.card ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    push Not
    use x
    exact Finset.mem_of_mem_filter x hx
  have hxp0 : ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with ¬ (i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2),
      (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    simp [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, γ.hookLength_ne_zero]
  have hxpt : ∏ i ∈ (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)).cells with ¬ (i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2),
      (γ.hookLength i : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact ENNReal.prod_ne_top (by simp)
  have hd : Disjoint ({y ∈ (γ.sub fun₀ | x.1 => 1).cells | y.1 = x.1})
      ({y ∈ (γ.sub fun₀ | x.1 => 1).cells | y.2 = x.2}) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    simp [mem_sub _ (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)), rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
    simp [corners] at hx
    grind
  unfold F
  rw [card_sub (sub_cond (subSingle_sub_cond hx)) (subSingle_le_rowLen' hx)]
  conv_lhs => simp [ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul]
  rw [ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, ENNReal.mul_inv (by simp) (by simp [Nat.factorial_ne_zero]),
    inv_inv, mul_assoc]
  nth_rw 2 [← mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_right_comm, ← Nat.mul_factorial_pred hγ, Nat.cast_mul,
    ENNReal.mul_inv (by simp) (by simp)]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_assoc]
  rw [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by simp [Nat.factorial_ne_zero]) (by simp), mul_one, mul_left_comm,
    ENNReal.mul_right_inj (by simp) (by simp [hγ]),
    ← Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not _ (fun i ↦ i.1 = x.1 ∨ i.2 = x.2),
    prod_sub_hookLength hx, Finset.prod_ite,
    ENNReal.mul_inv (by right; exact hxpt) (by right; exact hxp0), prod_hookLength_eq_sub hx,
    prod_hookLength_not_eq_sub hx, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hxp0 hxpt,
    mul_one, ENNReal.prod_inv_distrib (Set.pairwise_of_forall _ _ (by simp)), Finset.filter_or,
    Finset.prod_union hd, Finset.prod_union hd, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
    ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_comm]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_comm]
  rw [prod_range_hookLength hx, prod_range_hookLength' hx]

name: hookLength_add_of_mem_corners
statement:
lemma hookLength_add_of_mem_corners {γ : YoungDiagram} (x y : ℕ × ℕ) (hy : y ∈ γ.corners)
    (h : x ≤ y) :
    (γ.hookLength (x.1, y.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞) + (γ.hookLength (y.1, x.2) - 1) = γ.hookLength x - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hookLength, Nat.cast_add, ENNReal.natCast_sub, Nat.cast_one,
    ENNReal.addLECancellable_iff_ne, ne_eq, ENNReal.one_ne_top, not_false_eq_true,
    AddLECancellable.add_tsub_cancel_right]
  simp only [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hy
  obtain ⟨hy, hyr, hyc⟩ := hy
  rw [← hyr, ← hyc]
  rw [Prod.le_def] at h
  push_cast
  calc γ.rowLen x.1 - (y.2 + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) + ((y.1 + 1) - (x.1 + 1)) +
    (y.2 + 1 - (x.2 + 1) + (γ.colLen x.2 - (y.1 + 1)))
    _ = γ.rowLen x.1 - (y.2 + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) + (y.2 + 1 - (x.2 + 1)) +
    ((γ.colLen x.2 - (y.1 + 1)) + ((y.1 + 1) - (x.1 + 1))) := by ring
    _ = γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1) + ((γ.colLen x.2 - (y.1 + 1)) + ((y.1 + 1) - (x.1 + 1))) := by
      rw [tsub_add_tsub_cancel]
      · rw_mod_cast [hyr]
        exact γ.rowLen_anti _ _ h.1
      · simp [h.2]
    _ = γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1) + (γ.colLen x.2 - (x.1 + 1)) := by
      rw [tsub_add_tsub_cancel]
      · rw_mod_cast [hyc]
        exact γ.colLen_anti _ _ h.2
      · simp [h.1]

name: ENNReal.div_add_mul_add_div
statement:
lemma ENNReal.div_add_mul_add_div {a b : ℝ≥0∞} :
    (1 / (a + b)) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = (1 / a) * (1 / b)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hb0 : b = 0
  · simp [hb0]
  by_cases! hbt : b = ⊤
  · simp [hbt]
  by_cases! ha0 : a = 0
  · simp [ha0, hbt]
  by_cases! hat : a = ⊤
  · simp [hat]
  have ha : 1 / a = b / (a * b) := by rw [← ENNReal.mul_div_mul_right 1 a hb0 hbt, one_mul]
  have hb : 1 / b = a / (a * b) := by rw [← ENNReal.mul_div_mul_left 1 b ha0 hat, mul_one]
  conv_lhs => rw [ha, hb, ← ENNReal.add_div, add_comm, mul_div]
  rw [ENNReal.div_mul_cancel (by simp [hb0]) (by simp [hat, hbt]),
    ← ENNReal.mul_div_mul_comm (by grind) (by grind), one_mul]

name: measure_horz_vert_eq
statement:
lemma measure_horz_vert_eq {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) {s t : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : s ∈ (Finset.range x.1).powerset) (ht : t ∈ (Finset.range x.2).powerset) :
    1 / γ.card *
    ((∏ i ∈ s, 1 / (γ.hookLength (i, x.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)) *
    (∏ j ∈ t, 1 / (γ.hookLength (x.1, j) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞))) =
    pab hx s t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hs0 : s = ∅
  · simp [hs0, pab_empty_left_eq hx t ht]
  by_cases! ht0 : t = ∅
  · simp [ht0, pab_empty_right_eq hx s hs]
  rw [pab_recursion hx hs ht hs0 ht0]
  rw [← measure_horz_vert_eq hx (by grind) ht, ← measure_horz_vert_eq hx hs (by grind), ← mul_add]
  conv_rhs => rw [mul_left_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul s _ (Finset.min'_mem s hs0),
    ← Finset.prod_erase_mul t _ (Finset.min'_mem t ht0), mul_right_comm, ← mul_assoc]
  nth_rw 4 [mul_right_comm]
  rw [← left_distrib, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  have hxst : (s.min' hs0, t.min' ht0) ≤ x := by
    rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hs ht
    have hs' := hs (Finset.min'_mem _ hs0)
    have ht' := ht (Finset.min'_mem _ ht0)
    rw [Prod.le_def]
    grind
  rw [← hookLength_add_of_mem_corners (s.min' hs0, t.min' ht0) x hx hxst, add_comm,
    ENNReal.div_add_mul_add_div]
  termination_by (s.card + t.card)
  decreasing_by
  · rw [← ne_eq, ← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty] at hs0
    simp [Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem (Finset.min'_mem _ hs0)]
  · rw [← ne_eq, ← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty] at ht0
    simp [Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem (Finset.min'_mem _ ht0)]

name: sum_prod_eq_horz_vert
statement:
lemma sum_prod_eq_horz_vert {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    1 / γ.card *
    ∑ S ∈ (Finset.range x.1).powerset ×ˢ (Finset.range x.2).powerset,
    ((∏ i ∈ S.1, 1 / (γ.hookLength (i, x.2) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞)) *
    (∏ j ∈ S.2, 1 / (γ.hookLength (x.1, j) - 1 : ℝ≥0∞))) =
    ∑ S ∈ (Finset.range x.1).powerset ×ˢ (Finset.range x.2).powerset,
    (γ.pmf (ne_bot_of_mem_corners hx)).toMeasure
    {p : γ.cornerHookPath | p.1.horizontal = S.1 ∧ p.1.vertical = S.2
      ∧ p.1.path.getLast p.1.ne_nil = x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
  intro S hS
  simp only [Finset.mem_product] at hS
  exact measure_horz_vert_eq hx hS.1 hS.2

name: F_prob
statement:
theorem F_prob {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    (γ.pmf (ne_bot_of_mem_corners hx)).toMeasure
    {p : γ.cornerHookPath | p.1.path.getLast p.1.ne_nil = x} =
    F (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)) / F γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [F_div_eq_prod_mul_prod hx, Finset.prod_one_add, Finset.prod_one_add, Finset.sum_mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_product', sum_prod_eq_horz_vert hx, ← MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset]
  · congr 1
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powerset, Set.mem_iUnion,
      exists_and_left, exists_prop, Prod.exists]
    constructor
    · intro hpx
      subst hpx
      use p.1.horizontal.toFinset
      constructor
      · exact (Set.coe_toFinset _).symm
      use p.1.vertical.toFinset
      constructor
      · exact (Set.coe_toFinset _).symm
      constructor
      constructor
      · intro i
        simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_sdiff, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right,
          Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Finset.mem_range, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
        intro j hij
        have h := le_getLast_of_mem_path hij
        rw [Prod.le_def] at h
        lia
      · intro i
        simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_sdiff, Prod.exists, exists_eq_right,
          Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Finset.mem_range, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
        intro j hij
        have h := le_getLast_of_mem_path hij
        rw [Prod.le_def] at h
        lia
      · rfl
    · intro ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hpx⟩
      exact hpx
  · unfold Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.Pairwise
    simp only [Finset.coe_product, Finset.coe_powerset, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_prod,
      Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_powerset_iff, ne_eq, and_imp, Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq, not_and]
    intro s t hs ht s' t' hs' ht' h S hS hS' p hp
    have hp' := hS' hp
    have hp := hS hp
    grind
  · intro _ _
    exact DiscreteMeasurableSpace.forall_measurableSet _

name: ENNReal.sum_div
statement:
lemma ENNReal.sum_div {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (a : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a
proof:
:= by
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]

name: sum_subSingle_eq_sum_corners
statement:
lemma sum_subSingle_eq_sum_corners : ∑ a : SubSingle γ,
    (F (γ.sub (Finsupp.single a.1 1)) / F γ : ℝ≥0∞) =
    ∑ x ∈ γ.corners, (F (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)) / F γ)
proof:
:= by
  let e : SubSingle γ → ℕ × ℕ := fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ (a, (γ.rowLen a) - 1)
  refine Finset.sum_nbij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_univ, corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, forall_const,
    Subtype.forall, ge_iff_le, and_imp, e]
    intro a ha ha'
    specialize ha' a
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, rowLen'_eq_rowLen] at ha'
    constructor
    · rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
      lia
    constructor
    · lia
    · refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · suffices a < γ.colLen (γ.rowLen a - 1) by lia
        rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
        lia
      · rw [← Std.not_lt, ← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, Std.not_lt]
        specialize ha a
        simpa [rowLen'_eq_rowLen] using ha
  · intro ⟨a, ha⟩ _ ⟨b, hb⟩ _
    grind
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.mem_range, e]
    use ⟨x.1, ⟨subSingle_sub_cond hx, subSingle_le_rowLen' hx⟩⟩
    simp [corners] at hx
    simp [← hx.2.1]
  · simp [e]

name: sum_corners_div_eq_sum_corners_measure
statement:
lemma sum_corners_div_eq_sum_corners_measure (hγ : γ ≠ ⊥) : ∑ x ∈ γ.corners,
    (F (γ.sub (Finsupp.single x.1 1)) / F γ) =
    ∑ x ∈ γ.corners, (γ.pmf hγ).toMeasure
    {p : γ.cornerHookPath | p.1.path.getLast p.1.ne_nil = x}
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [F_prob hx]

name: union_corners_eq_univ
statement:
lemma union_corners_eq_univ : ⋃ x ∈ γ.corners,
    {p : γ.cornerHookPath | p.1.path.getLast p.1.ne_nil = x} = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [x.2]

name: subSingle_sum_eq_subRowLensType_sum
statement:
lemma subSingle_sum_eq_subRowLensType_sum {γ : YoungDiagram} : ∑ a : SubSingle γ,
    kostkaNumber (γ.sub (Finsupp.single a.1 1)) (Multiset.replicate (γ.card - 1) 1) =
    ∑ f ∈ {g : SubRowLensType γ | ∃ a : ℕ, g.1 = Finsupp.single a 1},
    kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (Multiset.replicate (γ.card - 1) 1)
proof:
:= by
  let e : SubSingle γ → SubRowLensType γ := fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨Finsupp.single a 1, ha⟩
  refine Finset.sum_nbij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · grind
  · intro ⟨a, ha⟩ _ ⟨b, hb⟩ _
    unfold SubRowLensType
    simp [e, Finsupp.single_left_inj]
  · intro ⟨f, hf⟩
    unfold SubRowLensType
    simp [e]
    grind
  · simp [e]

name: sum_support_gt_one
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hf : f.support.card • 1 > 1 := by lia
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hf <| Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ 1 (by grind)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le ha (Finset.single_le_sum (by lia) (by grind))

name: kostka_recursion_single
statement:
theorem kostka_recursion_single {γ : YoungDiagram} (hγ : γ.card ≠ 0) :
    kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate γ.card 1) = ∑ a : SubSingle γ,
    kostkaNumber (γ.sub (Finsupp.single a.1 1)) (Multiset.replicate (γ.card - 1) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : (Multiset.replicate γ.card 1).toList ≠ [] := by
    rw [ne_eq, Multiset.toList_eq_nil, Eq.comm, Multiset.eq_replicate]
    simp [hγ.symm]
  rw [kostka_recursion hμ (by simp [Multiset.mem_replicate]) (by simp),
    subSingle_sum_eq_subRowLensType_sum]
  symm
  classical refine Finset.sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_filter, true_and, not_exists]
    intro f ha
    refine kostka_ne_card _ _ ?_
    simp only [card_sub (sub_cond f.2.1) f.2.2, Multiset.replicate_toList, List.min_replicate,
      Multiset.erase_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ne_eq]
    by_cases! hf0 : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = 0
    · lia
    have hf := sum_support_subRowLensType_le_card (f := f)
    suffices ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x > 1 by lia
    refine sum_support_gt_one ?_
    contrapose! ha
    obtain ⟨hfs, hf1⟩ := ha
    interval_cases h : f.1.support.card
    · rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finsupp.support_eq_empty] at h
      simp [h] at hf0
    · rw [Finset.card_eq_one] at h
      obtain ⟨a, h⟩ := h
      have ha : f.1 a = 1 := by
        have ha : a ∈ f.1.support := by grind
        grind
      apply subset_of_eq at h
      rw [Finsupp.support_subset_singleton, ha] at h
      use a
  · simp [Multiset.erase_replicate]

name: ennreal_hookLength_formula
statement:
theorem ennreal_hookLength_formula (γ : YoungDiagram) :
    (kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate γ.card 1) : ℝ≥0∞) =
    Nat.factorial γ.card / ∏ x ∈ γ.cells, γ.hookLength x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hγ : γ = ⊥
  · simp only [hγ, bot_card, Multiset.replicate_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, cells_bot,
      Finset.prod_empty, ENNReal.div_self one_ne_zero ENNReal.one_ne_top]
    rw [← bot_eq_zero, kostka_bot_bot, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [ne_eq, eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero] at hγ
  rw [kostka_recursion_single hγ, Nat.cast_sum, ← coe_F, F_recursion hγ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
  intro x _
  have hx : γ.card - 1 = (γ.sub (fun₀ | x.1 => 1)).card := by
    simp [card_sub (sub_cond x.2.1) x.2.2]
  rw [hx]
  exact ennreal_hookLength_formula (γ.sub (fun₀ | x.1 => 1))
  termination_by γ.card
  decreasing_by
    suffices γ.card ≠ 0 by lia
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := x
    apply And.right at ha
    specialize ha a
    simp [rowLen'_eq_rowLen] at ha
    rw [ne_eq, ← eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero, eq_bot_iff_zero_zero_notMem,
      γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
    have h0 : γ.rowLen 0 ≥ γ.rowLen a := γ.rowLen_anti _ _ zero_le
    lia

name: YoungDiagram.disjoint_length_eq_length_lt_and_cornerHookPath
statement:
lemma disjoint_length_eq_length_lt_and_cornerHookPath (n : ℕ) : Disjoint
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1} : Finset _)
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length < n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} :
    Finset _)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hs' p hp
  have hp' := hs' hp
  apply hs at hp
  simp at hp hp'
  lia

name: YoungDiagram.disjoint_length_eq_length_eq_and_cornerHookPath
statement:
lemma disjoint_length_eq_length_eq_and_cornerHookPath (n : ℕ) : Disjoint
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1 + 1} : Finset _)
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} :
    Finset _)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hs' p hp
  have hp' := hs' hp
  apply hs at hp
  simp at hp hp'
  lia

name: YoungDiagram.card_hook_ne_eq_hookLength_sub_one
statement:
lemma card_hook_ne_eq_hookLength_sub_one {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ) :
    {y ∈ γ.hook x | y ≠ x}.card = γ.hookLength x - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : {y ∈ γ.hook x | y ≠ x} = (γ.hook x).erase x := by grind
  rw [h, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (self_mem_hook γ x hx), hook_card_eq_hookLength γ x hx]

name: YoungDiagram.pmf_fun_eq_div_mul_dropLast
statement:
lemma pmf_fun_eq_div_mul_dropLast {p : γ.hookPath} (hp : p.path.length > 1) :
    γ.pmf_fun p =
    1 / (γ.hookLength (p.dropLast.path.getLast p.dropLast.ne_nil) - 1) * γ.pmf_fun p.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  unfold pmf_fun
  have hγ : 1 / (γ.card : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [one_div, ne_eq, inv_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero, ← eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero,
      ne_bot_of_hookPath p, not_false_eq_true]
  simp only [mul_left_comm, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, hγ, or_false]
  have hps : ∏ i, 1 / (γ.hookLength (p.dropLast.path.get i) - 1 : ℝ≥0) =
      1 / (γ.hookLength (p.dropLast.path.getLast p.dropLast.ne_nil) - 1 : ℝ≥0) *
      ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p.dropLast.path.length))).erase
      ⟨p.dropLast.path.length - 1, by grind [hookPath_length_ne_zero]⟩,
      1 / (γ.hookLength (p.dropLast.path.get i) - 1 : ℝ≥0) := by
    simp_rw [List.get_eq_getElem]
    have ha : ⟨p.dropLast.path.length - 1, by grind [length_dropLast]⟩ ∈
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin p.dropLast.path.length)) := Finset.mem_univ _
    rw [List.getLast_eq_getElem, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ ha]
  simp_rw [← hps, List.get_eq_getElem]
  have hp : p.path.length = p.dropLast.path.length + 1 := by
    simp [length_dropLast, hp, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hp.le]
  symm
  rw! [hp]
  refine Finset.prod_nbij (Fin.castSucc (n := p.dropLast.path.length)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · grind
  · exact Set.injOn_of_injective (Fin.castSucc_injective _)
  · intro a
    simp
    grind
  · simp [getElem_dropLast_eq_getElem]

name: YoungDiagram.sum_hookPath_eq_sum_sum_one_hookPath
statement:
lemma sum_hookPath_eq_sum_sum_one_hookPath (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p : γ.hookPath with p.path.length = n + 1 + 1, 1 / γ.card *
    ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p.path.length))).erase ⟨p.path.length - 1, by
    grind [hookPath_length_ne_zero]⟩, 1 / ((γ.hookLength (p.path.get i) : ℝ≥0) - 1) =
    ∑ p : γ.hookPath with p.path.length = n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∉ γ.corners,
    ∑ x ∈ γ.hook (p.path.getLast p.ne_nil) with x ≠ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil,
    1 / γ.card * (1 / (γ.hookLength (p.path.getLast p.ne_nil) - 1)) *
    ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p.path.length))).erase ⟨p.path.length - 1, by
    grind [hookPath_length_ne_zero]⟩, 1 / ((γ.hookLength (p.path.get i) : ℝ≥0) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let R : Set (γ.hookPath × (ℕ × ℕ)) := { (p, x) | p.path.length = n + 1 ∧
    p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∉ γ.corners ∧ x ∈ γ.hook (p.path.getLast p.ne_nil) ∧
    x ≠ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil}
  have hR : Fintype R := by
    let e : R → γ.hookPath × (Finset.univ : Finset γ.hookPath).biUnion
      (fun p ↦ γ.hook (p.path.getLast p.ne_nil)) := fun ⟨(p, x), h⟩ ↦
      (p, ⟨x, by
        simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        use p
        exact h.2.2.1⟩)
    refine Fintype.ofInjective e ?_
    intro ⟨(p, x), hpx⟩ ⟨(q, y), hqy⟩ hpq
    simpa [e] using hpq
  rw [← Finset.sum_finset_product' R.toFinset _ _ (by grind)]
  let e : (p : γ.hookPath) →
    (hp : p ∈ Finset.filter (fun q ↦ q.path.length = n + 1 + 1) (Finset.univ : Finset _)) →
    γ.hookPath × (ℕ × ℕ) := fun p hp ↦ (p.dropLast, p.path.getLast p.ne_nil)
  refine Finset.sum_bij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, ne_eq, Set.mem_toFinset,
      Set.mem_setOf_eq, R, e]
    intro p hp
    simp [hp, length_dropLast, getLast_dropLast_notMem_corners, getLast_mem_hook_getLast_dropLast,
      getLast_ne_getLast_dropLast]
  · grind [eq_of_length_dropLast_getLast_eq]
  · simp only [ne_eq, Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and, exists_prop, and_imp, Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq, R, e]
    intro p i j hp hpc hij hijl
    use p.extend (i, j) hij hijl
    simp [hp, extend_length, dropLast_extend, getLast_extend]
  · unfold e
    intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
    nth_rw 3 [mul_comm]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pmf_fun, ← pmf_fun]
    exact pmf_fun_eq_div_mul_dropLast γ (by lia)

name: YoungDiagram.sum_partial_hookPath_pmf_eq_one
statement:
lemma sum_partial_hookPath_pmf_eq_one {n : ℕ} (hγ : γ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∑ p : γ.hookPath with p.path.length = n + 1 ∨
    (p.path.length < n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners), γ.pmf_fun p = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [zero_add, Order.lt_one_iff, List.length_eq_zero_iff, hookPath_ne_nil, false_and,
      or_false]
    have h : (1 : ℝ≥0) = ∑ p : γ.hookPath with p.path.length = 1, (1 / γ.card : ℝ≥0) := by
      rw [ne_eq, γ.eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero] at hγ
      simp [path_length_eq_one_card, hγ]
    conv_rhs => rw [h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro p hp
    simp at hp
    suffices (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p.path.length))).erase ⟨p.path.length - 1,
        by grind [hookPath_length_ne_zero]⟩ = ∅ by
      simp [pmf_fun, this]
    grind
  | succ n ih =>
    classical
    have hd := disjoint_length_eq_length_lt_and_cornerHookPath γ n
    conv_rhs => rw [← ih, Finset.filter_or, Finset.sum_union hd]
    symm
    have h : ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length < n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} :
        Finset _) ⊆ ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1 + 1 ∨
        p.path.length < n + 1 + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} : Finset _) := by grind
    rw [← eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le]
    · classical
      rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff h, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      have h' : ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1 + 1 ∨ (p.path.length < n + 1 + 1 ∧
          p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners)} : Finset _) \ ({p : γ.hookPath |
          p.path.length < n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} : Finset _) =
          ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1 + 1} : Finset _) ∪ ({p : γ.hookPath |
          p.path.length = n + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} : Finset _) := by grind
      have hd' := disjoint_length_eq_length_eq_and_cornerHookPath γ n
      rw [h', Finset.sum_union hd', ← Finset.sum_filter_not_add_sum_filter
        {p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = n + 1}
        (fun x : γ.hookPath ↦ x.path.getLast x.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners) _,
        Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter, add_left_inj]
      unfold pmf_fun
      rw [sum_hookPath_eq_sum_sum_one_hookPath γ n]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
      intro p hp
      let b : ℝ≥0 := ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ.erase ⟨p.path.length - 1, by grind⟩),
        1 / (γ.hookLength (p.path.get i) - 1)
      rw [Finset.sum_const b, nsmul_eq_mul]
      unfold b
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff]
      conv_rhs => simp only [one_div, NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_natCast, inv_eq_zero,
          Nat.cast_eq_zero, ← eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero, hγ]
      rw [or_false, card_hook_ne_eq_hookLength_sub_one γ (γ.getLast_mem p), ← mul_assoc]
      norm_cast
      rw [one_div_mul_cancel, one_mul]
      simp [mem_corners_iff_hookLength_eq_one _ (γ.getLast_mem p)] at hp
      have hhl := γ.hookLength_ne_zero (p.path.getLast p.ne_nil)
      rw [Nat.cast_ne_zero]
      lia
    · exact Finset.sum_mono_set_of_nonneg (by simp) h

name: YoungDiagram.cornerHookPath_eq_setOf_card_hookPath
statement:
lemma cornerHookPath_eq_setOf_card_hookPath :
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners} : Finset _) =
    ({p : γ.hookPath | p.path.length = γ.card + 1 ∨
    (p.path.length < γ.card + 1 ∧ p.path.getLast p.ne_nil ∈ γ.corners)} : Finset _)
proof:
:= by
  grind [hookPath_length_le_card]

name: YoungDiagram.hookLength_def
statement:
lemma hookLength_def (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) :
    γ.hookLength x = (γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1)) + (γ.colLen x.2 - (x.1 + 1)) + 1
proof: := by rfl

name: YoungDiagram.hookLength_eq_one_of_notMem
statement:
lemma hookLength_eq_one_of_notMem (γ : YoungDiagram) {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∉ γ) :
    γ.hookLength x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hookLength]
  grind [mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen]

name: YoungDiagram.corners_le
statement: lemma corners_le {γ : YoungDiagram} : γ.corners ≤ γ.cells
proof:
:= by
  simp [corners]

name: YoungDiagram.corners_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma corners_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).corners = ∅
proof: := by simp [corners]

name: YoungDiagram.ne_bot_of_mem_corners
statement: lemma ne_bot_of_mem_corners {γ : YoungDiagram} {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) : γ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply corners_le at hx
  rw [ne_eq, eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem]
  push Not
  use x.1, x.2
  exact hx

name: YoungDiagram.not_le_of_mem_corners
statement:
lemma not_le_of_mem_corners {γ : YoungDiagram} {x y : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners)
    (hy : y ∈ γ.corners) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ¬ x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hx hy
  rw [Prod.le_def, not_and]
  intro h
  apply γ.rowLen_anti at h
  grind

name: YoungDiagram.hook_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hook_of_notMem (γ : YoungDiagram) {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∉ γ) :
    γ.hook x = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hook, ge_iff_le, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff, mem_cells, Prod.forall]
  grind [γ.up_left_mem]

name: YoungDiagram.self_mem_hook
statement:
lemma self_mem_hook (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) (h : x ∈ γ) :
    x ∈ γ.hook x
proof: := by simp [hook, h]

name: YoungDiagram.mem_of_mem_hook
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_hook (γ : YoungDiagram) {x y : ℕ × ℕ} (h : x ∈ γ.hook y) : x ∈ γ
proof:
:= by
  simp_all [hook]

name: YoungDiagram.hook_card_eq_hookLength
statement:
lemma hook_card_eq_hookLength (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) (h : x ∈ γ) :
    (γ.hook x).card = γ.hookLength x
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ :=
    fun y ↦ if (y.1 = x.1 ∧ y.2 ≥ x.2) then y.2 - x.2 else γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1) + y.1 - x.1
  conv => rhs; rw [← Finset.card_range (γ.hookLength x)]
  refine Set.BijOn.finsetCard_eq f ?_
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hx
    simp only [hookLength_def, Finset.coe_range, ge_iff_le, Set.mem_Iio, f]
    grind [γ.mem_iff_lt_colLen, γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hook, mem_cells]
  constructor
  · grind [γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hook, mem_cells, Set.InjOn]
  · intro a
    simp only [hookLength_def, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, ge_iff_le, hook, Finset.coe_filter,
      mem_cells, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.exists, f]
    intro ha
    by_cases hah : a ≤ γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1)
    · use x.1, (a + x.2)
      simp only [le_add_iff_nonneg_left, zero_le, and_self, le_refl, Nat.add_eq_right, true_and,
        true_or, and_true, ↓reduceIte, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      rw [γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen] at h ⊢
      lia
    · use (a - (γ.rowLen x.1 - (x.2 + 1)) + x.1), x.2
      grind [γ.mem_iff_lt_colLen]

name: YoungDiagram.corner_iff_hookLength_eq_one
statement:
lemma corner_iff_hookLength_eq_one (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) (hx : x ∈ γ) :
    (x.2 + 1 = γ.rowLen x.1 ∧ x.1 + 1 = γ.colLen x.2) ↔ γ.hookLength x = 1
proof:
:= by
  grind [γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen, γ.mem_iff_lt_colLen, hookLength_def]

name: YoungDiagram.mem_corners_iff_hookLength_eq_one
statement:
lemma mem_corners_iff_hookLength_eq_one (γ : YoungDiagram) {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ) :
    x ∈ γ.corners ↔ γ.hookLength x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [← corner_iff_hookLength_eq_one _ _ hx, corners, hx]

name: YoungDiagram.mem_corners_iff_hook_eq_self
statement:
lemma mem_corners_iff_hook_eq_self (γ : YoungDiagram) {x : ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ γ.corners ↔ γ.hook x = {x}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hx : x ∈ γ
  · rw [mem_corners_iff_hookLength_eq_one γ hx, ← hook_card_eq_hookLength _ _ hx,
      Finset.card_eq_one]
    grind [self_mem_hook]
  · simp [hx, corners]

name: YoungDiagram.hookLength_ne_zero
statement: lemma hookLength_ne_zero (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) : γ.hookLength x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : x ∈ γ
  · rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ← hook_card_eq_hookLength _ _ h]
    refine Finset.card_pos.mpr ?_
    use x
    exact γ.self_mem_hook x h
  · rw [hookLength_eq_one_of_notMem _ h]
    exact zero_ne_one.symm

name: YoungDiagram.exists_hook_of_hookLength_ne_one
statement:
lemma exists_hook_of_hookLength_ne_one (γ : YoungDiagram) (x : ℕ × ℕ) (hij : x ∈ γ)
    (h : γ.hookLength x ≠ 1) : ∃ y ∈ γ.hook x, y ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.exists_mem_ne ?_ x
  rw [hook_card_eq_hookLength _ _ hij]
  have hhl := γ.hookLength_ne_zero x
  lia

name: YoungDiagram.le_of_mem_hook
statement: lemma le_of_mem_hook (γ : YoungDiagram) {x y : ℕ × ℕ} (h : x ∈ γ.hook y) : y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  grind [Prod.le_def, hook]

name: YoungDiagram.mem_of_mem_hook_right
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_hook_right (γ : YoungDiagram) {x y : ℕ × ℕ} (h : y ∈ γ.hook x) : x ∈ γ
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : x ≤ y := le_of_mem_hook γ h
  rw [Prod.le_def] at hxy
  exact γ.up_left_mem hxy.1 hxy.2 (γ.mem_of_mem_hook h)

name: subSingle_sub_cond
statement:
lemma subSingle_sub_cond {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, γ.rowLen' i - (Finsupp.single x.1 1) i ≥ γ.rowLen' (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hx
  obtain ⟨hx, hxr, hxc⟩ := hx
  intro i
  rw [Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [γ.rowLen'_eq_rowLen, ← hi, ← hxr, add_tsub_cancel_right, rowLen'_eq_rowLen, hxc,
      ge_iff_le, ← Std.not_lt, ← γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen, γ.mem_iff_lt_colLen]
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _
  · simp [γ.rowLen'_anti i.le_succ]

name: subSingle_le_rowLen'
statement:
lemma subSingle_le_rowLen' {x : ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ γ.corners) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, (Finsupp.single x.1 1) i ≤ γ.rowLen' i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [corners, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells] at hx
  obtain ⟨hx, hxr, hxc⟩ := hx
  intro i
  rw [Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with hi
  · refine Nat.le_of_pred_lt ?_
    rw [rowLen'_eq_rowLen, ← hi, ← γ.mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
    exact γ.up_left_mem (by rfl) zero_le hx
  · exact zero_le

name: coe_F
statement:
lemma coe_F :
    (F γ : ℝ≥0∞) = (γ.card).factorial / ∏ x ∈ γ.cells, γ.hookLength x
proof: := rfl

name: F_ne_zero
statement: lemma F_ne_zero : F γ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [F, Nat.factorial_ne_zero, ENNReal.prod_ne_top]

name: F_ne_top
statement: lemma F_ne_top : F γ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [F, ENNReal.div_eq_top, Nat.factorial_ne_zero, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, hookLength_ne_zero]

name: erase_min_eq_22_iff
statement:
lemma erase_min_eq_22_iff {hμ : μ.toList ≠ []} (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ) = {2, 2} ↔ μ = {2, 2, 1} ∨ μ = {2, 2, 2}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hμ' : μ.toList.min hμ ∈ μ := by
      rw [← Multiset.mem_toList]
      exact List.min_mem hμ
    have hm : μ.toList.min hμ = 1 ∨ μ.toList.min hμ = 2 := by
      suffices 0 < μ.toList.min hμ ∧ μ.toList.min hμ ≤ 2 by lia
      constructor
      · rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
        contrapose! h0
        rwa [← h0]
      · have h2 : 2 ∈ μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ) := by simp [h]
        apply Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase at h2
        rw [← Multiset.mem_toList] at h2
        exact List.min_le_of_mem h2
    rw [← Multiset.cons_erase hμ', h]
    rcases hm with hm | hm
    · left
      simp only [hm, Multiset.insert_eq_cons, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
      abel
    · right
      rw [hm]
      rfl
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · simp only [h, min_triple (by rfl) one_le_two]
      rfl
    · simp only [h, min_triple (by rfl) (by rfl)]
      rfl

name: sum_kostka_sub_eq_kostka
statement:
lemma sum_kostka_sub_eq_kostka (hγ : γ.card = n) :
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ, kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (Multiset.replicate n 1) =
    kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  conv => rhs; rw [← sub_zero γ]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, zero_subRowLensType⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _) ?_]
  intro f _ hf
  refine kostka_ne_card _ _ ?_
  rw [Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← hγ,
    card_sub (sub_cond f.2.1) f.2.2]
  suffices ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x ≠ 0 by
    let hasd := sum_support_subRowLensType_le_card f
    lia
  simp only [ne_eq, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, _root_.not_imp_self,
    not_forall]
  contrapose! hf
  suffices f.1 = (0 : ℕ →₀ ℕ) by
    rw [Subtype.coe_eq_iff] at this
    obtain ⟨_, this⟩ := this
    exact this
  ext x
  exact hf x

name: kostka_double_sum
statement:
lemma kostka_double_sum {k : ℕ} (h : γ.card - k = μ.sum) (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ with ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k, kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) μ =
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ with ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k,
    ∑ g : SubRowLensType (γ.sub f.1) with ∑ x ∈ g.1.support, g.1 x = μ.toList.min hμ,
    kostkaNumber ((γ.sub f.1).sub g.1) (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ))
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
  intro f hf
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hf
  refine kostka_recursion' hμ h0 ?_
  rw [card_sub (sub_cond f.2.1) f.2.2, hf, h]

name: subSubSetFinite
statement:
lemma subSubSetFinite (γ : YoungDiagram) (f : ℕ →₀ ℕ) :
    Finite {g : ℕ →₀ ℕ | ((∀ i, (γ.sub f).rowLen' i - g i ≥
    (γ.sub f).rowLen' (i + 1)) ∧ (∀ i, g i ≤ (γ.sub f).rowLen' i) ∧
    ∑ x ∈ g.support, g x = 1)}
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite {g : ℕ →₀ ℕ | g ≤ (γ.sub f).rowLen'} := instFiniteSubtypeLeOfLocallyFiniteOrderBot
  refine Finite.Set.subset {g : ℕ →₀ ℕ | g ≤ (γ.sub f).rowLen'} ?_
  intro g
  simp only [ge_iff_le, Set.mem_setOf_eq, and_imp]
  intro _ h _ i
  exact h i

name: Finset.prod_le_prod_of_injOn'
statement:
@[to_additive sum_le_sum_of_injOn]
theorem Finset.prod_le_prod_of_injOn' {ι α N : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [CommMonoid N]
    [PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] {f : ι → N} {g : α → N} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset α}
    (e : ι → α) (he : Set.InjOn e s) (ht : Finset.image e s ⊆ t) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g (e i))
    (hg : ∀ a ∈ t, a ∉ Finset.image e s → 1 ≤ g a) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ a ∈ t, g a
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ <| Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' ht hg
  grw [Finset.prod_image he, Finset.prod_le_prod' h]

name: kostka_sum_le_kostka_double_sum
statement:
lemma kostka_sum_le_kostka_double_sum {k : ℕ} :
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ with ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1, kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) μ ≤
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ with ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k,
    ∑ g ∈ subSubFinset γ f.1, kostkaNumber ((γ.sub f.1).sub g) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfinS : Finite {(f, g) : (SubRowLensType γ × (ℕ →₀ ℕ)) |
      ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k ∧ g ∈ subSubFinset γ f.1} := by
    have : {(f, g) : (SubRowLensType γ × (ℕ →₀ ℕ)) |
        ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k ∧ g ∈ subSubFinset γ f.1} =
        ⋃ f ∈ { f : SubRowLensType γ | ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k },
        (({f} : Set (SubRowLensType γ)) ×ˢ SetLike.coe (subSubFinset γ f.1)) := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [this]
    refine Set.finite_iUnion ?_
    intro f
    refine Set.finite_iUnion ?_
    intro hf
    simp [Set.finite_prod]
  let s : Finset (SubRowLensType γ × (ℕ →₀ ℕ)) := Set.Finite.toFinset hfinS
  rw [← Finset.sum_finset_product' s]
  · let e : (f : SubRowLensType γ) → (SubRowLensType γ × (ℕ →₀ ℕ)) :=
      fun f ↦ if hf : ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = k + 1 then
        (⟨f.1 - extractOne hf, extractOne_SubRowLensType hf⟩, extractOne hf) else
        (⟨0, zero_subRowLensType⟩, 0)
    classical refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_injOn e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro f₁ hf₁ f₂ hf₂ he
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hf₁ hf₂
      simp only [hf₁, ↓reduceDIte, hf₂, Prod.mk.injEq, e] at he
      unfold SubRowLensType at he ⊢
      rw [Subtype.mk_eq_mk] at he
      rw [← Subtype.coe_inj, ← extractOne_sub_add hf₁, ← extractOne_sub_add hf₂,
        he.1, he.2]
    · intro f hf
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hf
      obtain ⟨f', hf', heff⟩ := hf
      simp only [← heff, hf', ↓reduceDIte, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, s, e, subSubFinset]
      constructor
      · exact extractOne_sub_sum_support hf'
      constructor
      · exact extractOne_rowLen'_sub_self_ge hf'
      constructor
      · exact extractOne_le_sub hf'
      · exact extractOne_sum_support hf'
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      intro f hf
      simp only [hf, ↓reduceDIte, e]
      rw [sub_extractOne_eq_sub hf]
    · simp
  · simp [subSubFinset, s]

name: kostka_sum_sub_replicate_le
statement:
lemma kostka_sum_sub_replicate_le {k : ℕ} (hk : n > k) (hγ : γ.card = n) :
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ, kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (Multiset.replicate (n - k) 1) ≤
    kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [tsub_zero, sum_kostka_sub_eq_kostka hγ]
  | succ k ih =>
    refine le_trans ?_ (ih (by lia))
    rw [sum_subRowLensSumType ?_ ?_ (k + 1), sum_subRowLensSumType ?_ ?_ k,
      kostka_double_sum (k := k)]
    · have hnk : n - (k + 1) = n - k - 1 := by lia
      rw! [Multiset.replicate_toList, List.min_replicate, Multiset.erase_replicate, ← hnk]
      refine le_trans kostka_sum_le_kostka_double_sum ?_
      refine le_of_eq ?_
      refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
      intro f hf
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hf
      let e : (g : ℕ →₀ ℕ) → (hg : g ∈ subSubFinset γ f.1) → SubRowLensType (γ.sub f.1) :=
        fun g hg ↦ ⟨g, by
          simp only [subSubFinset, ge_iff_le, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hg
          constructor
          · exact hg.1
          · exact hg.2.1⟩
      refine Finset.sum_bij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simp [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, e, subSubFinset]
      · intro g₁ _ g₂ _ hg
        unfold e SubRowLensType at hg
        rwa [Subtype.mk_eq_mk] at hg
      · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, e]
        intro g hg
        use g.1
        simp [subSubFinset, hg, g.2.2, g.2.1]
      · simp [e]
    all_goals simp [hγ, Multiset.mem_replicate]
    all_goals lia

name: sum_subRowLensType_min_mul_kostka_sub_erase
statement:
lemma sum_subRowLensType_min_mul_kostka_sub_erase (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) (h0 : 0 ∉ μ)
    (hγ : γ.card = n) (hmc1 : μ.card > 1) (hnmin : n > μ.toList.min hμ) (hmp : μ.toList.min hμ > 0)
    (h : γ.card = μ.sum) (hμ' : μ.toList.min hμ ∈ μ)
    (hf : ∀ f : SubRowLensType γ, f ∈ Finset.univ →
      (n - μ.toList.min hμ - 1) * kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)) ≤
      (μ.card - 2) * kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (Multiset.replicate (n - (μ.toList.min hμ)) 1))
    (hrl' : ∀ f : SubRowLensType γ, (γ.sub f.1).card = (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).sum →
      (γ.sub f.1).rowLens.length ≠ 1) :
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ, (μ.toList.min hμ) * kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1)
    (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)) ≤
    ∑ f : SubRowLensType γ, kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1)
    (Multiset.replicate (n - μ.toList.min hμ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
  intro f _
  qify
  specialize hf f (Finset.mem_univ f)
  qify at hf
  by_cases hl : μ.card ≠ 2
  · rw [← div_le_iff₀' (by simp; lia)] at hf
    refine le_trans ?_ hf
    rw [mul_div_right_comm]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ ?_
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by simp; lia), Nat.cast_sub (by lia), mul_sub,
        Nat.cast_sub (by lia), Nat.cast_sub (by lia)]
      suffices μ.toList.min hμ * μ.card ≤ n by
        qify at this
        simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, tsub_le_iff_right, ge_iff_le]
        refine le_trans this ?_
        suffices n ≤ n - (μ.toList.min hμ) - 1 + μ.toList.min hμ * 2 by
          qify at this
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (by lia), Nat.cast_sub (by lia)] at this
          exact this
        lia
      rw [← hγ, h]
      have hxm : ∀ x ∈ μ, μ.toList.min hμ ≤ x := by
        intro x hx
        rw [← Multiset.mem_toList] at hx
        exact List.min_le_of_mem hx
      refine le_trans ?_ (Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum hxm)
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rfl
    · exact Nat.cast_nonneg' _
  · by_cases h' : (γ.sub f.1).card = (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).sum
    swap
    · simp [kostka_ne_card _ _ h']
    suffices ¬ (γ.sub f.1).rowLens ⊵ (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).sort (· ≥ ·) by
      rw [← kostka_pos_iff_dominates h', Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at this
      · push Not at this
        simp [this]
      · contrapose! h0
        exact Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase h0
    push Not at hl
    specialize hrl' f h'
    contrapose! hrl'
    apply lengths_le_of_dominates at hrl'
    specialize hrl' ?_ ?_
    · rw [← card_eq_sum_rowLens, Multiset.sort_sum, h']
    · intro i
      refine (γ.sub f.1).pos_of_mem_rowLens _ ?_
      exact List.get_mem _ _
    · simp only [ge_iff_le, Multiset.length_sort,
        Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hμ', hl, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one,
        Nat.add_one_sub_one] at hrl'
      suffices (γ.sub f.1).card ≠ 0 by
        rw [ne_eq, ← eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, bot_rowLens,
          ← List.length_eq_zero_iff] at this
        lia
      rw [h', ne_eq, Multiset.sum_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero, ← Multiset.card_eq_zero,
        Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hμ', hl]
      · norm_num
      · contrapose! h0
        exact Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase h0

name: kostka_ineq
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq (γ : YoungDiagram) (μ : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hγ : γ.card = n)
    (hsq : γ ≠ ofRowLens [2, 2] (by grind) ∨ μ ≠ {2, 2}) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤ (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn4 : n ≤ 4
  · exact kostka_ineq_small hhd h h0 hsq hγ hn4
  by_cases h221 : μ = {2, 2, 1}
  · refine kostka_ineq_221 hhd h h0 ?_ h221
    rw [← hγ, h, h221]
    norm_num
  by_cases h222 : μ = {2, 2, 2}
  · refine kostka_ineq_222 hhd h h0 ?_ h222
    rw [← hγ, h, h222]
    norm_num
  have hμ : μ.toList ≠ [] := by
    contrapose! hn4
    rw [← hγ, h, ← Multiset.sum_toList, hn4, List.sum_nil]
    norm_num
  have hμ' : μ.toList.min hμ ∈ μ := by
    rw [← Multiset.mem_toList]
    exact List.min_mem hμ
  by_cases hμn : μ = {n}
  · exact kostka_ineq_singleton hhd hμn h
  by_cases hcrl : γ.rowLens.length = 2 ∧ γ.rowLen 1 ≤ μ.toList.min hμ
  · rw [List.length_eq_two] at hcrl
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, hab⟩, hmin⟩ := hcrl
    have ha : a = n - b := by
      rw [← hγ, card_eq_sum_rowLens, hab]
      simp
    rw [ha] at hab
    refine kostka_ineq_two_rows hab (by lia) ?_ hγ h hμ h0 ?_
    · by_contra! hb0
      simp only [hb0, tsub_zero] at hab
      have h0 : 0 ∈ γ.rowLens := by simp [hab]
      apply γ.pos_of_mem_rowLens at h0
      contradiction
    · suffices b = γ.rowLen 1 by rwa [this]
      simp [← γ.get_rowLens, hab]
  have hrl : γ.rowLens.length ≠ 1 := by
    contrapose! hhd
    rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens (by lia)]
    rw [List.length_eq_one_iff] at hhd
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hhd
    rw [card_eq_sum_rowLens, hm, List.sum_singleton] at hγ
    rw [← hγ, hm]
  have hcrl : (γ.rowLens.length = 2 ∧ γ.rowLen 1 > μ.toList.min hμ) ∨ γ.rowLens.length > 2 := by
    push Not at hcrl
    by_cases hl : γ.rowLens.length = 2
    · simp [hl, hcrl]
    · simp only [hl, false_and, false_or]
      suffices γ.rowLens.length ≠ 0 by lia
      rw [ne_eq, List.length_eq_zero_iff]
      contrapose! hn4
      rw [← hγ, card_eq_sum_rowLens, hn4, List.sum_nil]
      norm_num
  have hrl' : ∀ f : SubRowLensType γ, (γ.sub f.1).card = (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).sum →
      (γ.sub f.1).rowLens.length ≠ 1 := by
    intro f h'
    suffices (γ.sub f.1).rowLen 1 > 0 by
      contrapose! this
      rw [Nat.le_zero]
      refine rowLen_eq_zero ?_
      rw [← length_rowLens, this]
      exact Nat.lt_irrefl 1
    rw [← rowLen'_eq_rowLen, sub_rowLen' (sub_cond f.2.1)]
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, gt_iff_lt]
    rcases hcrl with hcrl | hcrl
    · rw [tsub_pos_iff_lt, rowLen'_eq_rowLen]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hcrl.2
      suffices ∑ x ∈ f.1.support, f.1 x = μ.toList.min hμ by
        by_cases hfs : 1 ∈ f.1.support
        · rw [← this]
          refine Finset.single_le_sum ?_ hfs
          intro _ _
          exact Nat.zero_le _
        · rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hfs
          push Not at hfs
          rw [hfs]
          exact Nat.zero_le _
      rwa [card_sub (sub_cond f.2.1) f.2.2, Multiset.sum_erase' hμ', h, tsub_right_inj] at h'
      · exact h ▸ sum_support_subRowLensType_le_card f
      · exact Multiset.single_le_sum (by simp) _ hμ'
    · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (f.2.1 1)
      rw [rowLen'_eq_rowLen, ← mem_iff_lt_rowLen, mem_iff_lt_colLen,
        ← length_rowLens]
      exact hcrl
  rw [kostka_recursion hμ h0 h]
  have hmc1 : μ.card > 1 := by
    contrapose! hμn
    rw [ne_eq, Multiset.toList_eq_nil, ← Multiset.card_eq_zero] at hμ
    have hμn : μ.card = 1 := by lia
    rw [Multiset.card_eq_one] at hμn
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hμn
    rw [h, hm, Multiset.sum_singleton] at hγ
    rw [hm, hγ]
  have hnmin : n > μ.toList.min hμ := by
    contrapose! hmc1
    have hn0 : n > 0 := by lia
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hn0
    rw [← smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
    conv => rhs; rw [← hγ, h]
    refine Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [← Multiset.mem_toList] at hx
    exact le_trans hmc1 <| List.min_le_of_mem hx
  have hmp : μ.toList.min hμ > 0 := by
    contrapose! h0
    rw [Nat.le_zero] at h0
    rwa [← h0]
  have hnm : n - 1 = (n - μ.toList.min hμ - 1) + μ.toList.min hμ := by lia
  rw [hnm, add_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hf : ∀ f : SubRowLensType γ, f ∈ Finset.univ →
      (n - μ.toList.min hμ - 1) * kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)) ≤
      (μ.card - 2) * kostkaNumber (γ.sub f.1) (Multiset.replicate (n - (μ.toList.min hμ)) 1) := by
    intro f _
    by_cases h' : (γ.sub f.1).card = (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).sum
    · have : μ.card - 2 = (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).card - 1 := by
        rw [Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hμ', Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
        lia
      rw [this]
      refine kostka_ineq _ _ _ ?_ h' ?_ ?_ ?_
      · rw [ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens (by lia)]
        apply_fun List.length
        rw [List.length_singleton]
        exact hrl' f h'
      · contrapose! h0
        exact Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase h0
      · rw [h', Multiset.sum_erase' hμ', ← h, hγ]
      · right
        rw [ne_eq, erase_min_eq_22_iff h0, not_or]
        constructor
        · exact h221
        · exact h222
    · simp [kostka_ne_card _ _ h']
  refine le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.sum_le_sum hf) _) ?_
  have hsum2 := sum_subRowLensType_min_mul_kostka_sub_erase hμ h0 hγ hmc1 hnmin hmp h hμ' hf hrl'
  refine le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left hsum2 _) ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Nat.add_one_mul]
  have hmc1 : μ.card - 1 ≠ 0 := by lia
  have hmc : μ.card - 2 + 1 = μ.card - 1 := by lia
  rw [hmc]
  refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_
  exact kostka_sum_sub_replicate_le hnmin hγ

name: padZeros_parts_counts_sum
statement:
lemma padZeros_parts_counts_sum {d : ℕ} (μ : Nat.Partition d) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≥ d) :
    (padZeros_parts μ n).counts.sum = n
proof:
:= by
  have hnμ : n ≥ μ.parts.card := by
    refine le_trans ?_ h
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_of_eq μ.parts_sum)
    refine μ.parts.card_le_sum ?_
    intro _ hx
    exact μ.parts_pos hx
  simp [padZeros_parts, Multiset.sum_counts_eq_card]
  lia

name: kostka_inequality
statement:
theorem kostka_inequality {n d : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 2) (hnd : n > d)
    (γ : YoungDiagram) (hγc : γ.card = n) (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) :
    (kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)) *
    (∑ μ : Nat.Partition d, kostkaNumber (hookDiagram n) (padZeros_parts μ n).counts) ≥
    (kostkaNumber (hookDiagram n) (Multiset.replicate n 1)) *
    (∑ μ : Nat.Partition d, kostkaNumber γ ((padZeros_parts μ n).counts))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostka_hook_replicate _ (by lia)]
  have hsn : ∑ μ : Nat.Partition d, kostkaNumber (hookDiagram n)
      (padZeros_parts μ n).counts = ∑ μ : Nat.Partition d,
      ((padZeros_parts μ n).counts.card - 1) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) ?_
    intro μ _
    nth_rw 1 [← padZeros_parts_counts_sum μ (le_of_lt hnd)]
    rw [kostka_hook]
    · exact Multiset.zero_notMem_counts _
    · rw [padZeros_parts_counts_sum μ (le_of_lt hnd)]
      exact hn
  rw [hsn, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  by_cases! hγ : γ ≠ ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl)) ∨ d = 3 ∨ d = 1
  · refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    intro μ _
    conv => rhs; rw [mul_comm]
    refine kostka_ineq γ (padZeros_parts μ n).counts n hhd ?_ (by simp) hγc ?_
    · rw [hγc, padZeros_parts_counts_sum μ (le_of_lt hnd)]
    · rcases hγ with hγ | hd3 | hd1
      · left
        exact hγ
      · right
        subst hd3
        have hp := partition3 μ.parts μ.parts_sum (fun _ ↦ μ.parts_pos)
        rcases hp with hp | hp | hp
        · apply_fun Multiset.count 1
          simp [padZeros_parts, hp, Multiset.counts, Multiset.mem_replicate]
        · apply_fun Multiset.count 1
          simp [padZeros_parts, hp, Multiset.counts, Multiset.mem_replicate]
        · apply_fun Multiset.count 3
          simp [padZeros_parts, hp, Multiset.counts, Multiset.mem_replicate]
      · right
        subst hd1
        apply_fun Multiset.count 1
        simp [padZeros_parts, Multiset.counts, Multiset.mem_replicate]
  obtain ⟨hγ, hd3⟩ := hγ
  have hn4 : n = 4 := by
    apply_fun YoungDiagram.card at hγ
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, or_self, forall_eq, Nat.ofNat_pos,
      card_ofRowLens, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, Nat.reduceAdd] at hγ
    rw [← hγc, hγ]
  subst hn4
  interval_cases d
  · have h0r : Multiset.replicate 4 0 = 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ {0} := by rfl
    simp only [Finset.univ_unique, hγ, Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.replicate_zero,
      Multiset.cons_zero, padZeros_parts, Nat.Partition.partition_zero_parts, Multiset.card_zero,
      tsub_zero, Multiset.add_zero, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, smul_eq_mul, one_mul,
      Nat.add_one_sub_one, ge_iff_le]
    rw [← h0r, Multiset.counts_replicate _ (by lia)]
    suffices ¬ 0 < kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) {4} by
      rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, not_not] at this
      simp [this]
    rw [kostka_pos_iff_dominates]
    · simp [rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, pair_dominates_singleton]
    · simp
    · simp
  · contradiction
  swap
  · contradiction
  have h02 : (0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ {2}).counts = {3, 1} := by rfl
  have h10 : (1 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ {1}).counts = {2, 2} := by rfl
  have h1r : Multiset.replicate 4 1 = 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ {1} := by rfl
  suffices 3 * kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) (0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ {2}).counts
      + 3 * kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) (1 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ {1}).counts
      ≤ kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ {1}) +
      kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ {1}) by
    simpa [nat_partition2, hγ, padZeros_parts, Multiset.counts_card]
  have h22 : Multiset.ofList (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))).rowLens = {2, 2} := by
    rw [rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self (by simp)]
    rfl
  rw [← h1r, kostka_22, h02, h10, ← h22, kostka_self]
  suffices ¬ 0 < kostkaNumber (ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl))) {3, 1} by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, not_not] at this
    rw [this]
    norm_num
  rw [kostka_pos_iff_dominates, sort_pair_ge (by norm_num), rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self,
    pair_dominates_pair]
  all_goals simp

name: kostka_ineq_221
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq_221 (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hn : n = 5) (hμ : μ = {2, 2, 1}) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤
    (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  have h5 := partition5 (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens)
    (by simp [Multiset.sum_coe, ← card_eq_sum_rowLens, h, hμ])
    (by
      simp only [Multiset.mem_coe, gt_iff_lt]
      exact γ.pos_of_mem_rowLens)
  by_cases! hd : ¬ γ.rowLens ⊵ μ.sort (· ≥ ·)
  · exact kostka_ineq_not_dominate hd h h0
  rcases h5 with h5 | h5 | h5 | h5 | h5 | h5 | h5
  · rw [ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens] at hhd
    · rw [Multiset.coe_eq_singleton] at h5
      contradiction
    · lia
  · refine kostka_ineq_hook (by lia) ?_ h h0
    rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', h5, hookDiagram_rowLens]
    · rfl
    · norm_num
  · have h5' : γ = ofRowLens [3, 2] (sorted_pair (by norm_num)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, h5]
      · rfl
      · grind
    rw [hμ, h5', kostka_32]
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ kostka_g32u221_le) (by norm_num)
  · have h5' : γ = ofRowLens [3, 1, 1] (sorted_triple (by norm_num) (by rfl)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, h5]
      · rfl
      · grind
    grw [hμ, h5', kostka_311, kostka_g311u221]
    norm_num
  · have h5' : γ = ofRowLens [2, 2, 1] (sorted_triple (by rfl) (by norm_num)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, h5]
      · rfl
      · grind
    rw [hμ, ← h5, kostka_self, h5, h5', kostka_221]
    norm_num
  · have h5' : γ.rowLens = [2, 1, 1, 1] := by
      refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise (by simp) ?_
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h5]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, sort_triple_ge (by rfl) (by norm_num), h5', quad_dominates_triple] at hd
    simp at hd
  · exact kostka_ineq_vertical h5 h h0

name: kostka_ineq_222
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq_222 (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hn : n = 6) (hμ : μ = {2, 2, 2}) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤
    (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  have h6 := partition6 (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens)
    (by
      rw [Multiset.sum_coe, ← card_eq_sum_rowLens, h, hμ]
      norm_num)
    (by
      simp only [Multiset.mem_coe, gt_iff_lt]
      exact γ.pos_of_mem_rowLens)
  by_cases! hd : ¬ γ.rowLens ⊵ μ.sort (· ≥ ·)
  · exact kostka_ineq_not_dominate hd h h0
  rcases h6 with h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6 | h6
  · rw [Multiset.coe_eq_singleton] at h6
    rw [ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens] at hhd
    · contradiction
    · positivity
  · have h6' : γ = hookDiagram 6 := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', hookDiagram_rowLens, h6]
      · rfl
      · norm_num
    refine kostka_ineq_hook ?_ h6' h h0
    norm_num
  · have hγ : γ.rowLens = [6 - 2, 2] := by
      norm_num1
      refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise (by simp) ?_
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h6]
      rfl
    refine kostka_ineq_two_rows hγ ?_ (by norm_num) ?_ h ?_ h0 ?_
    · norm_num1
    · rw [card_eq_sum_rowLens, hγ]
      norm_num
    · simp [hμ]
    · simp only [min_triple (by rfl) (by rfl), hμ]
      rfl
  · have h6' : γ = ofRowLens [4, 1, 1] (sorted_triple (by norm_num) (by rfl)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self (by simp), h6]
      rfl
    grw [hμ, h6', kostka_411, kostka_g411u222]
    norm_num
  · have h6' : γ = ofRowLens [3, 3] (sorted_pair (by rfl)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self (by simp), h6]
      rfl
    grw [hμ, h6', kostka_33, kostka_g33u222]
    norm_num
  · have h6' : γ = ofRowLens [3, 2, 1] (sorted_triple (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self (by simp), h6]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, h6', kostka_321]
    refine le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ kostka_g321u222_le) ?_
    norm_num
  · have h6' : γ.rowLens = [3, 1, 1, 1] := by
      refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise (by simp) ?_
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h6]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, h6', sort_triple_ge (by rfl) (by rfl), quad_dominates_triple] at hd
    simp at hd
  · have h6' : γ = ofRowLens [2, 2, 2] (sorted_triple (by rfl) (by rfl)) := by
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self (by simp), h6]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, ← h6, kostka_self, h6, h6', kostka_222]
    norm_num
  · have h6' : γ.rowLens = [2, 2, 1, 1] := by
      refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise (by simp) ?_
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h6]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, h6', sort_triple_ge (by rfl) (by rfl), quad_dominates_triple] at hd
    simp at hd
  · have h6' : γ.rowLens = [2, 1, 1, 1, 1] := by
      refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise (by simp) ?_
      rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, h6]
      rfl
    rw [hμ, h6', sort_triple_ge (by rfl) (by rfl)] at hd
    apply sum_three_le_of_dominates at hd
    simp at hd
  · exact kostka_ineq_vertical h6 h h0

name: kostka_replicate_two_rows
statement:
theorem kostka_replicate_two_rows (h2 : γ.rowLens = [n - p, p])
    (hn : n ≥ 5) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hγ : γ.card = n) :
    ((Nat.factorial p) * (Nat.factorial (n - p + 1))) *
    kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1) = (Nat.factorial n) * (n - 2 * p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hpn : p ≤ n - p := by
    have hrls := γ.rowLens_sorted
    rwa [h2, List.sortedGE_iff_pairwise, List.pairwise_pair] at hrls
  have hk0 : kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, kostka_pos_iff_dominates]
    · rw [h2, Multiset.sort_eq_replicate_iff.mpr (by rfl)]
      refine dominates_replicate_one ?_ ?_
      all_goals simp; lia
    · simp [hγ, Multiset.sum_replicate]
    · simp [Multiset.mem_replicate]
  suffices ∏ x ∈ γ.cells, γ.hookLength x =
      p.factorial * (n - 2 * p).factorial * (n - p + 1).descFactorial p by
    rw [← hookLength_formula γ hγ, this]
    nth_rw 2 [mul_assoc]
    nth_rw 7 [mul_comm]
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff, hk0, or_false]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, Nat.factorial_ne_zero, or_false]
    nth_rw 3 [mul_comm]
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    nth_rw 2 [mul_comm]
    rw [← Nat.factorial_succ, show n - 2 * p + 1 = (n - p + 1) - p by lia,
      Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial (by lia)]
  rw [← Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not _ (fun x : ℕ × ℕ ↦ x.1 = 1)]
  nth_rw 2 [← Finset.prod_filter_not_mul_prod_filter _ (fun x : ℕ × ℕ ↦ x.2 < p)]
  simp_rw [Finset.filter_filter]
  have hr0 : γ.rowLen 0 = n - p := by
    rw [← get_rowLens]
    · simp [h2]
    · simp [h2]
  have hr1 : γ.rowLen 1 = p := by
    rw [← get_rowLens]
    · simp [h2]
    · simp [h2]
  have hr2 : γ.rowLen 2 = 0 := by
    refine rowLen_eq_zero ?_
    simp [← length_rowLens, h2]
  have hi0 : ∀ i j : ℕ, (i, j) ∈ γ → i ≠ 1 → i = 0 := by
    intro i j hij hi
    rw [mem_iff_lt_colLen] at hij
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt' (γ.colLen_anti 0 j (Nat.zero_le j)) at hij
    simp only [← length_rowLens, h2, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add,
      Nat.reduceAdd] at hij
    lia
  have hhl1 : ∏ x ∈ γ.cells with x.1 = 1, γ.hookLength x = p.factorial := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial]
    let e : (i : ℕ) → (hi : i ∈ Finset.range p) → ℕ × ℕ := fun i hi ↦ (1, (p-1)-i)
    rw [Finset.prod_bij e]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, and_true, e]
      intro i _
      rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr1]
      lia
    · simp [e]
      lia
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop, and_imp, Prod.forall,
        Prod.mk.injEq, e]
      intro i j hij hi
      use p - 1 - j
      rw [hi, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr1] at hij
      lia
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, hookLength_def, hr1, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff, e]
      intro i hi
      suffices γ.colLen (p - 1 - i) = 2 by lia
      have hcle : γ.colLen (p - 1 - i) ≤ 2 := by
        refine le_trans (γ.colLen_anti 0 _ (Nat.zero_le _)) ?_
        simp [← length_rowLens, h2]
      suffices 1 < γ.colLen (p - 1 - i) by lia
      rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr1]
      lia
  have hhl2 : ∏ x ∈ γ.cells with ¬x.1 = 1 ∧ ¬x.2 < p,
      γ.hookLength x = (n - 2 * p).factorial := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial]
    let e : (i : ℕ) → (hi : i ∈ Finset.range (n - 2 * p)) → ℕ × ℕ :=
      fun i _ ↦ (0, n - p - 1 - i)
    rw [Finset.prod_bij e]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, zero_ne_one,
        not_false_eq_true, true_and, e]
      intro i hi
      constructor
      · rw [mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr0]
        lia
      · lia
    · simp [e]
      lia
    · simp only [not_lt, Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop, and_imp,
        Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq, e]
      intro i j hij hi hj
      use n - p - 1 - j
      specialize hi0 i j hij hi
      rw [hi0, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr0] at hij
      lia
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, hookLength_def, hr0, zero_add, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff, e]
      intro i hi
      suffices γ.colLen (n - p - 1 - i) = 1 by lia
      suffices ¬ 1 < γ.colLen (n - p - 1 - i) ∧ 0 < γ.colLen (n - p - 1 - i) by lia
      constructor
      · rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr1]
        lia
      · rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr0]
        lia
  have hhl3 : ∏ x ∈ γ.cells with ¬x.1 = 1 ∧ x.2 < p,
      γ.hookLength x = (n - p + 1).descFactorial p := by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range]
    let e : (i : ℕ) → (hi : i ∈ Finset.range p) → ℕ × ℕ := fun i _ ↦ (0, i)
    rw [Finset.prod_bij e]
    · simp [mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr0, e]
      lia
    · simp [e]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_cells, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop, and_imp, Prod.forall,
        Prod.mk.injEq, exists_eq_right_right, e]
      intro i j hij hi
      specialize hi0 i j hij hi
      simp [hi0]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, hookLength_def, hr0, zero_add, e]
      intro i hi
      suffices γ.colLen i = 2 by lia
      suffices ¬ 2 < γ.colLen i ∧ 1 < γ.colLen i by lia
      simp_rw [← mem_iff_lt_colLen, mem_iff_lt_rowLen, hr1, hr2]
      lia
  rw [hhl1, hhl2, hhl3]
  ring

name: kostka_ineq_small2
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq_small2 (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hγ : γ.card = n) (hn : n = 2) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤ (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  have hp2 := partition2 μ ?_ (by grind)
  · rcases hp2 with hp2 | hp2
    · exact kostka_ineq_singleton hhd hp2 h
    · exact kostka_ineq_replicate (by simp [hp2])
  · rw [← h, hγ]

name: kostka_ineq_small3
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq_small3 (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hγ : γ.card = n) (hn : n = 3) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤ (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  have hp3 := partition3 (Multiset.ofList (γ.rowLens)) ?_ γ.pos_of_mem_rowLens
  · rcases hp3 with h3 | h3 | h3
    · simp only [Multiset.coe_eq_singleton] at h3
      rw [ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens (by norm_num)] at hhd
      contradiction
    · refine kostka_ineq_hook (by norm_num) ?_ h h0
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', h3, hookDiagram_rowLens]
      · rfl
      · norm_num
    · exact kostka_ineq_vertical h3 h h0
  · rw [Multiset.sum_coe, ← card_eq_sum_rowLens, hγ]

name: kostka_ineq_small4
statement:
theorem kostka_ineq_small4 (hhd : γ ≠ horizontalDiagram n) (h : γ.card = μ.sum)
    (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (hsq : γ ≠ ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl)) ∨ μ ≠ {2, 2})
    (hγ : γ.card = n) (hn : n = 4) :
    (n - 1) * kostkaNumber γ μ ≤ (μ.card - 1) * kostkaNumber γ (Multiset.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  by_cases! hd : ¬ γ.rowLens ⊵ μ.sort (· ≥ ·)
  · exact kostka_ineq_not_dominate hd h h0
  by_cases hμ1 : μ = {1, 1, 1, 1}
  · refine kostka_ineq_replicate ?_
    rw [hμ1]
    rfl
  have hp4 := partition4 (Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens) ?_ γ.pos_of_mem_rowLens
  · rcases hp4 with h4 | h4 | h4 | h4 | h4
    · rw [Multiset.coe_eq_singleton] at h4
      rw [ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, horizontalDiagram_rowLens (by norm_num)] at hhd
      contradiction
    · refine kostka_ineq_hook (by norm_num) ?_ h h0
      rw [eq_iff_rowLens_eq', h4, hookDiagram_rowLens]
      · rfl
      · norm_num
    · have hμ4 := partition4 μ (by rw [← h, hγ]) (by grind)
      have h4 : γ.rowLens = [2, 2] := by
        refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' γ.rowLens_sorted.pairwise
          (sorted_pair (by rfl)).pairwise ?_
        rwa [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe]
      · rcases hμ4 with hμ4 | hμ4 | hμ4 | hμ4 | hμ4
        · simp [hμ4, Multiset.sort_singleton, h4, pair_dominates_singleton] at hd
        · rw [hμ4, sort_pair_ge (by norm_num), h4] at hd
          simp [pair_dominates_pair] at hd
        · rw [hμ4, ne_eq, eq_iff_rowLens_eq, rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, h4] at hsq
          · contradiction
          · simp
        · have hγ4 : γ = ofRowLens [2, 2] (sorted_pair (by rfl)) := by
            simp [eq_iff_rowLens_eq, rowLens_ofRowLens_eq_self, h4]
          grw [hγ4, hμ4, kostka_22, kostka_g22u211]
          norm_num
